# Instruction: The State of Global Education — Progress, Gaps, and Inequality

## Overview

Create an A1 portrait poster for public exhibition that tells a compelling data story about global education. The narrative arc is one of **dramatic progress followed by a sobering reality check**: humanity has gone from fewer than 1-in-5 adults being educated to more than 4-in-5 — yet 244 million children remain out of school, and in the poorest countries, children receive fewer than 3 years of quality schooling compared to 10+ in wealthy nations. The audience is the general public, so clarity and visual impact matter more than academic detail.

## Key Priorities

- **The "progress vs. gaps" contrast is the heart of the poster.** The historical transformation (1800 → today) should feel triumphant, but the learning crisis and out-of-school figures must land with equal weight — don't let one overshadow the other.
- **Make the 244 million children stat visually dominant.** This is the number viewers should remember after walking away.
- **The comparison between quality schooling in the poorest vs. richest countries (< 3 years vs. 10+ years)** should be immediately graspable — consider a bold side-by-side or bar contrast.

## Visual & Style Guidance

Adopt a **data-forward yet engaging** tone. Use a clean, modern layout with generous whitespace. Think deep navy or charcoal backgrounds with warm accent colors (amber, coral) to highlight key figures. Typography should be bold and hierarchical — large numerals for headline stats, concise labels beneath. Infographic elements (icon arrays, simple bar comparisons) are welcome; avoid clutter. The overall mood should feel serious and authoritative but accessible — not academic, not flashy.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data, key messages).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for poster requirements, sections, metrics, and style definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output the final poster to `/app/output/final_poster.png`.
2. The poster must be a single self-contained image file.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — do not pause, ask questions, or wait for a reply. When encountering BLOCKING or wait-for-user instructions, make a professional judgment and continue.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `poster.tone`, `poster.audience`, etc., use them to choose templates, palettes, and styles. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.

# The State of Global Education: Progress, Gaps, and Inequality

A data-driven comparison of how education access, quality, and equity have evolved worldwide — and where critical challenges remain.

## Two Centuries of Educational Expansion

In the early 1800s, fewer than 1 in 5 adults worldwide had received any formal education. Education was a luxury reserved for a small elite. Over the past two centuries, this ratio has reversed dramatically. Today, more than 4 in 5 adults (aged 15+) have received some formal primary, secondary, or tertiary education. Literacy rates have followed a similar trajectory: two centuries ago, very few could read and write; now, the vast majority of adults possess basic literacy skills.

## The Learning Crisis: Being in School ≠ Learning

International statistics often track enrollment and attendance as markers of progress. However, being enrolled does not guarantee quality learning. In many lower-income countries, fewer than 20% of children achieve minimum reading proficiency by the end of primary school — meaning they cannot identify key ideas in a text or connect them to their own experiences. The data reveals a stark learning crisis hidden behind enrollment numbers.

## 244 Million Children Still Out of School

Despite enormous progress, approximately 244 million children of official school age were not enrolled in primary or secondary education in 2023. A major driver is secondary-level dropout: many children who complete primary school do not continue. The following table summarizes the scale of the challenge:

| Indicator | Value (2023) |
|---|---|
| Children out of school (all levels) | ~244 million |
| Primary-age children out of school | ~60 million |
| Secondary-age adolescents out of school | ~184 million |

## Learning-Adjusted Years of Schooling: A World Divided

Researchers combine the quantity and quality of education into a single metric called "learning-adjusted years of schooling." The disparities are enormous:

| Country Group | Learning-Adjusted Years of Schooling (2020) |
|---|---|
| Poorest countries (parts of Sub-Saharan Africa) | < 3 years |
| South Asia & Sub-Saharan Africa average | < 7 years |
| High-income countries | 10+ years |

Children in the world's poorest nations receive less than a third of the quality schooling available to their peers in wealthy countries. Most of the world's children live in South Asia and Sub-Saharan Africa, where the average remains below 7 years.

## Closing the Gender Gap

Historically, boys were far more likely to attend school than girls. Today, the global gender gap in enrollment has largely closed across primary and secondary education. At the tertiary level, young women are now more likely to be enrolled than young men.

| Education Level | Gender Gap Status (2023) |
|---|---|
| Primary | Nearly closed globally |
| Secondary | Nearly closed globally |
| Tertiary | Women now exceed men in enrollment |

However, significant exceptions persist. In countries like Afghanistan, girls remain far less likely to attend school at any level.

## Key Takeaway

The world has achieved remarkable progress — but the job is far from done. Hundreds of millions of children are either out of school or learning very little while in it. Closing the gap between enrollment and actual learning, and between rich and poor nations, is one of the most pressing challenges of our time.

# The State of Global Education: Progress, Gaps, and Inequality

A data-driven comparison of how education access, quality, and equity have evolved worldwide — and where critical challenges remain.

## Two Centuries of Educational Expansion

In the early 1800s, fewer than 1 in 5 adults worldwide had received any formal education. Education was a luxury reserved for a small elite. Over the past two centuries, this ratio has reversed dramatically. Today, more than 4 in 5 adults (aged 15+) have received some formal primary, secondary, or tertiary education. Literacy rates have followed a similar trajectory: two centuries ago, very few could read and write; now, the vast majority of adults possess basic literacy skills.

## The Learning Crisis: Being in School ≠ Learning

International statistics often track enrollment and attendance as markers of progress. However, being enrolled does not guarantee quality learning. In many lower-income countries, fewer than 20% of children achieve minimum reading proficiency by the end of primary school — meaning they cannot identify key ideas in a text or connect them to their own experiences. The data reveals a stark learning crisis hidden behind enrollment numbers.

## 244 Million Children Still Out of School

Despite enormous progress, approximately 244 million children of official school age were not enrolled in primary or secondary education in 2023. A major driver is secondary-level dropout: many children who complete primary school do not continue. The following table summarizes the scale of the challenge:

| Indicator | Value (2023) |
|---|---|
| Children out of school (all levels) | ~244 million |
| Primary-age children out of school | ~60 million |
| Secondary-age adolescents out of school | ~184 million |

## Learning-Adjusted Years of Schooling: A World Divided

Researchers combine the quantity and quality of education into a single metric called "learning-adjusted years of schooling." The disparities are enormous:

| Country Group | Learning-Adjusted Years of Schooling (2020) |
|---|---|
| Poorest countries (parts of Sub-Saharan Africa) | < 3 years |
| South Asia & Sub-Saharan Africa average | < 7 years |
| High-income countries | 10+ years |

Children in the world's poorest nations receive less than a third of the quality schooling available to their peers in wealthy countries. Most of the world's children live in South Asia and Sub-Saharan Africa, where the average remains below 7 years.

## Closing the Gender Gap

Historically, boys were far more likely to attend school than girls. Today, the global gender gap in enrollment has largely closed across primary and secondary education. At the tertiary level, young women are now more likely to be enrolled than young men.

| Education Level | Gender Gap Status (2023) |
|---|---|
| Primary | Nearly closed globally |
| Secondary | Nearly closed globally |
| Tertiary | Women now exceed men in enrollment |

However, significant exceptions persist. In countries like Afghanistan, girls remain far less likely to attend school at any level.

## Key Takeaway

The world has achieved remarkable progress — but the job is far from done. Hundreds of millions of children are either out of school or learning very little while in it. Closing the gap between enrollment and actual learning, and between rich and poor nations, is one of the most pressing challenges of our time.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate A1 portrait poster: The State of Global Education."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math
import os

# A1 portrait at 150 DPI: 594mm x 841mm → 3508 x 4961 px
W, H = 3508, 4961

# Colors
BG = (25, 32, 48)           # deep navy
BG_CARD = (35, 45, 65)      # card background
AMBER = (255, 179, 43)      # warm accent
CORAL = (255, 99, 72)       # alert accent
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
LIGHT_GRAY = (180, 190, 210)
MID_GRAY = (120, 135, 160)
TEAL = (72, 199, 190)       # positive accent
DARK_CARD = (30, 38, 55)
PROGRESS_GREEN = (100, 210, 140)

# Fonts
FONT_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"
FONT_REG = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"


def font(size, bold=False):
    return ImageFont.truetype(FONT_BOLD if bold else FONT_REG, size)


def text_width(draw, text, f):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=f)
    return bbox[2] - bbox[0]


def text_height(draw, text, f):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=f)
    return bbox[3] - bbox[1]


def draw_centered(draw, text, y, f, fill=WHITE):
    tw = text_width(draw, text, f)
    draw.text(((W - tw) / 2, y), text, font=f, fill=fill)
    return y + text_height(draw, text, f)


def draw_rounded_rect(draw, xy, radius, fill):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=radius, fill=fill)


def draw_person_icon(draw, cx, cy, size, fill):
    """Draw a simplified person icon (head + body)."""
    head_r = size * 0.18
    draw.ellipse(
        [cx - head_r, cy - size * 0.45 - head_r,
         cx + head_r, cy - size * 0.45 + head_r],
        fill=fill
    )
    body_top = cy - size * 0.45 + head_r + size * 0.04
    body_bottom = cy + size * 0.45
    body_half_w = size * 0.22
    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        [cx - body_half_w, body_top, cx + body_half_w, body_bottom],
        radius=size * 0.08, fill=fill
    )


def draw_waffle_grid(draw, x, y, total, highlighted, cols, cell_size, gap, fill_on, fill_off):
    """Draw a waffle chart (grid of squares)."""
    rows_needed = math.ceil(total / cols)
    for i in range(total):
        r = i // cols
        c = i % cols
        cx = x + c * (cell_size + gap)
        cy = y + r * (cell_size + gap)
        color = fill_on if i < highlighted else fill_off
        draw.rounded_rectangle(
            [cx, cy, cx + cell_size, cy + cell_size],
            radius=cell_size * 0.15, fill=color
        )
    return rows_needed * (cell_size + gap)


def draw_section_label(draw, x, y, text, fill=AMBER):
    f = font(42, bold=True)
    draw.text((x, y), text.upper(), font=f, fill=fill)
    line_y = y + text_height(draw, text.upper(), f) + 10
    tw = text_width(draw, text.upper(), f)
    draw.line([(x, line_y), (x + tw, line_y)], fill=fill, width=4)
    return line_y + 25


def wrap_text(draw, text, f, max_width):
    words = text.split()
    lines = []
    current = ""
    for word in words:
        test = f"{current} {word}".strip()
        if text_width(draw, test, f) <= max_width:
            current = test
        else:
            if current:
                lines.append(current)
            current = word
    if current:
        lines.append(current)
    return lines


def main():
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    MARGIN = 180
    CONTENT_W = W - 2 * MARGIN
    y = 100

    # === HEADER AREA ===
    # Top accent line
    draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, 12], fill=AMBER)

    y = 80

    # Title
    title_font = font(108, bold=True)
    title_text = "The State of Global Education"
    tw = text_width(draw, title_text, title_font)
    draw.text(((W - tw) / 2, y), title_text, font=title_font, fill=WHITE)
    y += text_height(draw, title_text, title_font) + 20

    subtitle_font = font(62, bold=False)
    sub_text = "Progress, Gaps, and Inequality"
    sw = text_width(draw, sub_text, subtitle_font)
    draw.text(((W - sw) / 2, y), sub_text, font=subtitle_font, fill=AMBER)
    y += text_height(draw, sub_text, subtitle_font) + 30

    # One-liner
    oneliner_font = font(40)
    oneliner = "A comparative look at how far the world has come in expanding education access — and the critical gaps that remain."
    lines = wrap_text(draw, oneliner, oneliner_font, CONTENT_W - 200)
    for line in lines:
        lw = text_width(draw, line, oneliner_font)
        draw.text(((W - lw) / 2, y), line, font=oneliner_font, fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
        y += text_height(draw, line, oneliner_font) + 8
    y += 20

    # Divider
    draw.line([(MARGIN, y), (W - MARGIN, y)], fill=MID_GRAY, width=3)
    y += 50

    # ============================================================
    # SECTION 1: TWO CENTURIES OF PROGRESS (Icon array comparison)
    # ============================================================
    y = draw_section_label(draw, MARGIN, y, "Two Centuries of Educational Expansion")
    y += 10

    # Two side-by-side panels
    panel_w = (CONTENT_W - 60) // 2
    panel_h = 520
    left_x = MARGIN
    right_x = MARGIN + panel_w + 60

    # Left panel: 1800
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, [left_x, y, left_x + panel_w, y + panel_h], 30, BG_CARD)
    # Right panel: Today
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, [right_x, y, right_x + panel_w, y + panel_h], 30, BG_CARD)

    # Left panel content
    yr_font = font(52, bold=True)
    draw.text((left_x + 50, y + 30), "1800", font=yr_font, fill=MID_GRAY)

    stat_font = font(110, bold=True)
    draw.text((left_x + 50, y + 100), "<1 in 5", font=stat_font, fill=CORAL)

    desc_font = font(38)
    draw.text((left_x + 50, y + 230), "adults had any formal", font=desc_font, fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    draw.text((left_x + 50, y + 278), "education", font=desc_font, fill=LIGHT_GRAY)

    # Icon array for 1800: 2 out of 10
    icon_start_x = left_x + 50
    icon_y = y + 360
    icon_spacing = 80
    for i in range(10):
        ix = icon_start_x + i * icon_spacing
        c = CORAL if i < 2 else (55, 65, 85)
        draw_person_icon(draw, ix + 30, icon_y + 40, 60, c)

    # Right panel content
    draw.text((right_x + 50, y + 30), "TODAY", font=yr_font, fill=TEAL)

    draw.text((right_x + 50, y + 100), ">4 in 5", font=stat_font, fill=TEAL)

    draw.text((right_x + 50, y + 230), "adults have received", font=desc_font, fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    draw.text((right_x + 50, y + 278), "formal education", font=desc_font, fill=LIGHT_GRAY)

    # Icon array for today: 8 out of 10
    icon_start_x2 = right_x + 50
    for i in range(10):

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate A1 portrait poster: The State of Global Education."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math
import os

# A1 portrait at 150 DPI: 594mm x 841mm → 3508 x 4961 px
W, H = 3508, 4961

# Colors
BG = (25, 32, 48)           # deep navy
BG_CARD = (35, 45, 65)      # card background
AMBER = (255, 179, 43)      # warm accent
CORAL = (255, 99, 72)       # alert accent
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
LIGHT_GRAY = (180, 190, 210)
MID_GRAY = (120, 135, 160)
TEAL = (72, 199, 190)       # positive accent
DARK_CARD = (30, 38, 55)
PROGRESS_GREEN = (100, 210, 140)

# Fonts
FONT_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"
FONT_REG = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"


def font(size, bold=False):
    return ImageFont.truetype(FONT_BOLD if bold else FONT_REG, size)


def text_width(draw, text, f):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=f)
    return bbox[2] - bbox[0]


def text_height(draw, text, f):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=f)
    return bbox[3] - bbox[1]


def draw_centered(draw, text, y, f, fill=WHITE):
    tw = text_width(draw, text, f)
    draw.text(((W - tw) / 2, y), text, font=f, fill=fill)
    return y + text_height(draw, text, f)


def draw_rounded_rect(draw, xy, radius, fill):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=radius, fill=fill)


def draw_person_icon(draw, cx, cy, size, fill):
    """Draw a simplified person icon (head + body)."""
    head_r = size * 0.18
    draw.ellipse(
        [cx - head_r, cy - size * 0.45 - head_r,
         cx + head_r, cy - size * 0.45 + head_r],
        fill=fill
    )
    body_top = cy - size * 0.45 + head_r + size * 0.04
    body_bottom = cy + size * 0.45
    body_half_w = size * 0.22
    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        [cx - body_half_w, body_top, cx + body_half_w, body_bottom],
        radius=size * 0.08, fill=fill
    )


def draw_waffle_grid(draw, x, y, total, highlighted, cols, cell_size, gap, fill_on, fill_off):
    """Draw a waffle chart (grid of squares)."""
    rows_needed = math.ceil(total / cols)
    for i in range(total):
        r = i // cols
        c = i % cols
        cx = x + c * (cell_size + gap)
        cy = y + r * (cell_size + gap)
        color = fill_on if i < highlighted else fill_off
        draw.rounded_rectangle(
            [cx, cy, cx + cell_size, cy + cell_size],
            radius=cell_size * 0.15, fill=color
        )
    return rows_needed * (cell_size + gap)


def draw_section_label(draw, x, y, text, fill=AMBER):
    f = font(42, bold=True)
    draw.text((x, y), text.upper(), font=f, fill=fill)
    line_y = y + text_height(draw, text.upper(), f) + 10
    tw = text_width(draw, text.upper(), f)
    draw.line([(x, line_y), (x + tw, line_y)], fill=fill, width=4)
    return line_y + 25


def wrap_text(draw, text, f, max_width):
    words = text.split()
    lines = []
    current = ""
    for word in words:
        test = f"{current} {word}".strip()
        if text_width(draw, test, f) <= max_width:
            current = test
        else:
            if current:
                lines.append(current)
            current = word
    if current:
        lines.append(current)
    return lines

    """Draw a simplified person icon (head + body)."""
    head_r = size * 0.18
    draw.ellipse(

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate A1 portrait poster: The State of Global Education."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math
import os

# A1 portrait at 150 DPI: 594mm x 841mm → 3508 x 4961 px
W, H = 3508, 4961

# Colors
BG = (25, 32, 48)           # deep navy
BG_CARD = (35, 45, 65)      # card background
AMBER = (255, 179, 43)      # warm accent
CORAL = (255, 99, 72)       # alert accent
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
LIGHT_GRAY = (180, 190, 210)
MID_GRAY = (120, 135, 160)
TEAL = (72, 199, 190)       # positive accent
DARK_CARD = (30, 38, 55)
PROGRESS_GREEN = (100, 210, 140)

# Fonts
FONT_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"
FONT_REG = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"


def font(size, bold=False):
    return ImageFont.truetype(FONT_BOLD if bold else FONT_REG, size)


def text_width(draw, text, f):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=f)
    return bbox[2] - bbox[0]


def text_height(draw, text, f):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=f)
    return bbox[3] - bbox[1]


def draw_centered(draw, text, y, f, fill=WHITE):
    tw = text_width(draw, text, f)
    draw.text(((W - tw) / 2, y), text, font=f, fill=fill)
    return y + text_height(draw, text, f)


def draw_rounded_rect(draw, xy, radius, fill):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=radius, fill=fill)


def draw_person_icon(draw, cx, cy, size, fill):
    """Draw a simplified person icon (head + body)."""
    head_r = size * 0.18
    draw.ellipse(
        [cx - head_r, cy - size * 0.45 - head_r,
         cx + head_r, cy - size * 0.45 + head_r],
        fill=fill
    )
    body_top = cy - size * 0.45 + head_r + size * 0.04
    body_bottom = cy + size * 0.45
    body_half_w = size * 0.22
    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        [cx - body_half_w, body_top, cx + body_half_w, body_bottom],
        radius=size * 0.08, fill=fill
    )


def draw_waffle_grid(draw, x, y, total, highlighted, cols, cell_size, gap, fill_on, fill_off):
    """Draw a waffle chart (grid of squares)."""
    rows_needed = math.ceil(total / cols)
    for i in range(total):
        r = i // cols
        c = i % cols
        cx = x + c * (cell_size + gap)
        cy = y + r * (cell_size + gap)
        color = fill_on if i < highlighted else fill_off
        draw.rounded_rectangle(
            [cx, cy, cx + cell_size, cy + cell_size],
            radius=cell_size * 0.15, fill=color
        )
    return rows_needed * (cell_size + gap)


def draw_section_label(draw, x, y, text, fill=AMBER):
    f = font(42, bold=True)
    draw.text((x, y), text.upper(), font=f, fill=fill)
    line_y = y + text_height(draw, text.upper(), f) + 10
    tw = text_width(draw, text.upper(), f)
    draw.line([(x, line_y), (x + tw, line_y)], fill=fill, width=4)
    return line_y + 25


def wrap_text(draw, text, f, max_width):
    words = text.split()
    lines = []
    current = ""
    for word in words:
        test = f"{current} {word}".strip()
        if text_width(draw, test, f) <= max_width:
            current = test
        else:
            if current:
                lines.append(current)
            current = word
    if current:
        lines.append(current)
    return lines


def main():
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    MARGIN = 180
    CONTENT_W = W - 2 * MARGIN
    y = 100

    # === HEADER AREA ===
    # Top accent line
    draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, 12], fill=AMBER)

    y = 80

    # Title
    title_font = font(108, bold=True)
    title_text = "The State of Global Education"
    tw = text_width(draw, title_text, title_font)
    draw.text(((W - tw) / 2, y), title_text, font=title_font, fill=WHITE)
    y += text_height(draw, title_text, title_font) + 20

    subtitle_font = font(62, bold=False)
    sub_text = "Progress, Gaps, and Inequality"
    sw = text_width(draw, sub_text, subtitle_font)
    draw.text(((W - sw) / 2, y), sub_text, font=subtitle_font, fill=AMBER)
    y += text_height(draw, sub_text, subtitle_font) + 30

    # One-liner
    oneliner_font = font(40)
    oneliner = "A comparative look at how far the world has come in expanding education access — and the critical gaps that remain."
    lines = wrap_text(draw, oneliner, oneliner_font, CONTENT_W - 200)
    for line in lines:
        lw = text_width(draw, line, oneliner_font)
        draw.text(((W - lw) / 2, y), line, font=oneliner_font, fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
        y += text_height(draw, line, oneliner_font) + 8
    y += 20

    # Divider
    draw.line([(MARGIN, y), (W - MARGIN, y)], fill=MID_GRAY, width=3)
    y += 50

    # ============================================================
    # SECTION 1: TWO CENTURIES OF PROGRESS (Icon array comparison)
    # ============================================================
    y = draw_section_label(draw, MARGIN, y, "Two Centuries of Educational Expansion")
    y += 10

    # Two side-by-side panels
    panel_w = (CONTENT_W - 60) // 2
    panel_h = 520
    left_x = MARGIN
    right_x = MARGIN + panel_w + 60

    # Left panel: 1800
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, [left_x, y, left_x + panel_w, y + panel_h], 30, BG_CARD)
    # Right panel: Today
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, [right_x, y, right_x + panel_w, y + panel_h], 30, BG_CARD)

    # Left panel content
    yr_font = font(52, bold=True)
    draw.text((left_x + 50, y + 30), "1800", font=yr_font, fill=MID_GRAY)

    stat_font = font(110, bold=True)
    draw.text((left_x + 50, y + 100), "<1 in 5", font=stat_font, fill=CORAL)

    desc_font = font(38)
    draw.text((left_x + 50, y + 230), "adults had any formal", font=desc_font, fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    draw.text((left_x + 50, y + 278), "education", font=desc_font, fill=LIGHT_GRAY)

    # Icon array for 1800: 2 out of 10
    icon_start_x = left_x + 50
    icon_y = y + 360
    icon_spacing = 80
    for i in range(10):
        ix = icon_start_x + i * icon_spacing
        c = CORAL if i < 2 else (55, 65, 85)
        draw_person_icon(draw, ix + 30, icon_y + 40, 60, c)

    # Right panel content
    draw.text((right_x + 50, y + 30), "TODAY", font=yr_font, fill=TEAL)

    draw.text((right_x + 50, y + 100), ">4 in 5", font=stat_font, fill=TEAL)

    draw.text((right_x + 50, y + 230), "adults have received", font=desc_font, fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    draw.text((right_x + 50, y + 278), "formal education", font=desc_font, fill=LIGHT_GRAY)

    # Icon array for today: 8 out of 10
    icon_start_x2 = right_x + 50
    for i in range(10):
        ix = icon_start_x2 + i * icon_spacing
        c = TEAL if i < 8 else (55, 65, 85)
        draw_person_icon(draw, ix + 30, icon_y + 40, 60, c)

    # Arrow between panels
    arrow_cx = MARGIN + panel_w + 30
    arrow_cy = y + panel_h // 2
    arrow_size = 25
    draw.polygon([
        (arrow_cx - arrow_size, arrow_cy - arrow_size),
        (arrow_cx + arrow_size, arrow_cy),
        (arrow_cx - arrow_size, arrow_cy + arrow_size)
    ], fill=AMBER)

    y += panel_h + 60

    # ============================================================
    # SECTION 2: 244 MILLION CHILDREN — HERO STAT (visually dominant)
    # ============================================================
    hero_h = 680
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, [MARGIN - 40, y, W - MARGIN + 40, y + hero_h], 40, (45, 20, 20))
    # Subtle border
    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        [MARGIN - 40, y, W - MARGIN + 40, y + hero_h],
        radius=40, outline=CORAL, width=6
    )

    hero_label_font = font(48, bold=True)
    label_y = y + 45
    label_text = "THE CHALLENGE THAT REMAINS"
    lw = text_width(draw, label_text, hero_label_font)
    draw.text(((W - lw) / 2, label_y), label_text, font=hero_label_font, fill=CORAL)

    # Giant number
    giant_font = font(260, bold=True)
    num_text = "244"
    nw = text_width(draw, num_text, giant_font)
    nh = text_height(draw, num_text, giant_font)
    num_y = label_y + 80
    draw.text(((W - nw) / 2, num_y), num_text, font=giant_font, fill=WHITE)

    million_font = font(100, bold=True)
    mil_text = "MILLION"
    mw = text_width(draw, mil_text, million_font)
    mil_y = num_y + nh + 10
    draw.text(((W - mw) / 2, mil_y), mil_text, font=million_font, fill=CORAL)

    children_font = font(56, bold=False)
    child_text = "children of school age are not in school"
    cw = text_width(draw, child_text, children_font)
    child_y = mil_y + text_height(draw, mil_text, million_font) + 25
    draw.text(((W - cw) / 2, child_y), child_text, font=children_font, fill=LIGHT_GRAY)

    # Breakdown bar
    bar_y = child_y + 90
    bar_left = MARGIN + 100
    bar_right = W - MARGIN - 100
    bar_total_w = bar_right - bar_left
    bar_h = 80

    primary_frac = 60 / 244
    secondary_frac = 184 / 244
    primary_w = int(bar_total_w * primary_frac)
    secondary_w = bar_total_w - primary_w

    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        [bar_left, bar_y, bar_left + primary_w - 4, bar_y + bar_h],
        radius=15, fill=(255, 140, 60)
    )
    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        [bar_left + primary_w + 4, bar_y, bar_right, bar_y + bar_h],
        radius=15, fill=CORAL
    )

    bar_label_font = font(32, bold=True)
    # Primary label
    p_text = "60M Primary"
    draw.text((bar_left + 20, bar_y + 24), p_text, font=bar_label_font, fill=WHITE)
    # Secondary label

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate A1 portrait poster: The State of Global Education."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math
import os

# A1 portrait at 150 DPI: 594mm x 841mm → 3508 x 4961 px
W, H = 3508, 4961

# Colors
BG = (25, 32, 48)           # deep navy
BG_CARD = (35, 45, 65)      # card background
AMBER = (255, 179, 43)      # warm accent
CORAL = (255, 99, 72)       # alert accent
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
LIGHT_GRAY = (180, 190, 210)
MID_GRAY = (120, 135, 160)
TEAL = (72, 199, 190)       # positive accent
DARK_CARD = (30, 38, 55)
PROGRESS_GREEN = (100, 210, 140)

# Fonts
FONT_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"
FONT_REG = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"


def font(size, bold=False):
    return ImageFont.truetype(FONT_BOLD if bold else FONT_REG, size)


def text_width(draw, text, f):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=f)
    return bbox[2] - bbox[0]


def text_height(draw, text, f):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=f)
    return bbox[3] - bbox[1]


def draw_centered(draw, text, y, f, fill=WHITE):
    tw = text_width(draw, text, f)
    draw.text(((W - tw) / 2, y), text, font=f, fill=fill)
    return y + text_height(draw, text, f)


def draw_rounded_rect(draw, xy, radius, fill):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=radius, fill=fill)


def draw_person_icon(draw, cx, cy, size, fill):
    """Draw a simplified person icon (head + body)."""
    head_r = size * 0.18
    draw.ellipse(
        [cx - head_r, cy - size * 0.45 - head_r,
         cx + head_r, cy - size * 0.45 + head_r],
        fill=fill
    )
    body_top = cy - size * 0.45 + head_r + size * 0.04
    body_bottom = cy + size * 0.45
    body_half_w = size * 0.22
    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        [cx - body_half_w, body_top, cx + body_half_w, body_bottom],
        radius=size * 0.08, fill=fill
    )


def draw_waffle_grid(draw, x, y, total, highlighted, cols, cell_size, gap, fill_on, fill_off):
    """Draw a waffle chart (grid of squares)."""
    rows_needed = math.ceil(total / cols)
    for i in range(total):
        r = i // cols
        c = i % cols
        cx = x + c * (cell_size + gap)
        cy = y + r * (cell_size + gap)
        color = fill_on if i < highlighted else fill_off
        draw.rounded_rectangle(
            [cx, cy, cx + cell_size, cy + cell_size],
            radius=cell_size * 0.15, fill=color
        )
    return rows_needed * (cell_size + gap)


def draw_section_label(draw, x, y, text, fill=AMBER):
    f = font(42, bold=True)
    draw.text((x, y), text.upper(), font=f, fill=fill)
    line_y = y + text_height(draw, text.upper(), f) + 10
    tw = text_width(draw, text.upper(), f)
    draw.line([(x, line_y), (x + tw, line_y)], fill=fill, width=4)
    return line_y + 25


def wrap_text(draw, text, f, max_width):
    words = text.split()
    lines = []
    current = ""
    for word in words:
        test = f"{current} {word}".strip()
        if text_width(draw, test, f) <= max_width:
            current = test
        else:
            if current:
                lines.append(current)
            current = word
    if current:
        lines.append(current)
    return lines


def main():
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    MARGIN = 180
    CONTENT_W = W - 2 * MARGIN
    y = 100

    # === HEADER AREA ===
    # Top accent line
    draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, 12], fill=AMBER)

    y = 80

    # Title
    title_font = font(108, bold=True)
    title_text = "The State of Global Education"
    tw = text_width(draw, title_text, title_font)
    draw.text(((W - tw) / 2, y), title_text, font=title_font, fill=WHITE)
    y += text_height(draw, title_text, title_font) + 20

    subtitle_font = font(62, bold=False)
    sub_text = "Progress, Gaps, and Inequality"
    sw = text_width(draw, sub_text, subtitle_font)
    draw.text(((W - sw) / 2, y), sub_text, font=subtitle_font, fill=AMBER)
    y += text_height(draw, sub_text, subtitle_font) + 30

    # One-liner
    oneliner_font = font(40)
    oneliner = "A comparative look at how far the world has come in expanding education access — and the critical gaps that remain."
    lines = wrap_text(draw, oneliner, oneliner_font, CONTENT_W - 200)
    for line in lines:
        lw = text_width(draw, line, oneliner_font)
        draw.text(((W - lw) / 2, y), line, font=oneliner_font, fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
        y += text_height(draw, line, oneliner_font) + 8
    y += 20

    # Divider
    draw.line([(MARGIN, y), (W - MARGIN, y)], fill=MID_GRAY, width=3)
    y += 50

    # ============================================================
    # SECTION 1: TWO CENTURIES OF PROGRESS (Icon array comparison)
    # ============================================================
    y = draw_section_label(draw, MARGIN, y, "Two Centuries of Educational Expansion")
    y += 10

    # Two side-by-side panels
    panel_w = (CONTENT_W - 60) // 2
    panel_h = 520
    left_x = MARGIN
    right_x = MARGIN + panel_w + 60

    # Left panel: 1800
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, [left_x, y, left_x + panel_w, y + panel_h], 30, BG_CARD)
    # Right panel: Today
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, [right_x, y, right_x + panel_w, y + panel_h], 30, BG_CARD)

    # Left panel content
    yr_font = font(52, bold=True)
    draw.text((left_x + 50, y + 30), "1800", font=yr_font, fill=MID_GRAY)

    stat_font = font(110, bold=True)
    draw.text((left_x + 50, y + 100), "<1 in 5", font=stat_font, fill=CORAL)

    desc_font = font(38)
    draw.text((left_x + 50, y + 230), "adults had any formal", font=desc_font, fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    draw.text((left_x + 50, y + 278), "education", font=desc_font, fill=LIGHT_GRAY)

    # Icon array for 1800: 2 out of 10
    icon_start_x = left_x + 50
    icon_y = y + 360
    icon_spacing = 80
    for i in range(10):
        ix = icon_start_x + i * icon_spacing
        c = CORAL if i < 2 else (55, 65, 85)
        draw_person_icon(draw, ix + 30, icon_y + 40, 60, c)

    # Right panel content
    draw.text((right_x + 50, y + 30), "TODAY", font=yr_font, fill=TEAL)

    draw.text((right_x + 50, y + 100), ">4 in 5", font=stat_font, fill=TEAL)

    draw.text((right_x + 50, y + 230), "adults have received", font=desc_font, fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    draw.text((right_x + 50, y + 278), "formal education", font=desc_font, fill=LIGHT_GRAY)

    # Icon array for today: 8 out of 10
    icon_start_x2 = right_x + 50
    for i in range(10):
        ix = icon_start_x2 + i * icon_spacing
        c = TEAL if i < 8 else (55, 65, 85)
        draw_person_icon(draw, ix + 30, icon_y + 40, 60, c)

    # Arrow between panels
    arrow_cx = MARGIN + panel_w + 30
    arrow_cy = y + panel_h // 2
    arrow_size = 25
    draw.polygon([
        (arrow_cx - arrow_size, arrow_cy - arrow_size),
        (arrow_cx + arrow_size, arrow_cy),
        (arrow_cx - arrow_size, arrow_cy + arrow_size)
    ], fill=AMBER)

    y += panel_h + 60

    # ============================================================
    # SECTION 2: 244 MILLION CHILDREN — HERO STAT (visually dominant)
    # ============================================================
    hero_h = 680
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, [MARGIN - 40, y, W - MARGIN + 40, y + hero_h], 40, (45, 20, 20))
    # Subtle border
    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        [MARGIN - 40, y, W - MARGIN + 40, y + hero_h],
        radius=40, outline=CORAL, width=6
    )

    hero_label_font = font(48, bold=True)
    label_y = y + 45
    label_text = "THE CHALLENGE THAT REMAINS"
    lw = text_width(draw, label_text, hero_label_font)
    draw.text(((W - lw) / 2, label_y), label_text, font=hero_label_font, fill=CORAL)

    # Giant number
    giant_font = font(260, bold=True)
    num_text = "244"
    nw = text_width(draw, num_text, giant_font)
    nh = text_height(draw, num_text, giant_font)
    num_y = label_y + 80
    draw.text(((W - nw) / 2, num_y), num_text, font=giant_font, fill=WHITE)

    million_font = font(100, bold=True)
    mil_text = "MILLION"
    mw = text_width(draw, mil_text, million_font)
    mil_y = num_y + nh + 10
    draw.text(((W - mw) / 2, mil_y), mil_text, font=million_font, fill=CORAL)

    children_font = font(56, bold=False)
    child_text = "children of school age are not in school"
    cw = text_width(draw, child_text, children_font)
    child_y = mil_y + text_height(draw, mil_text, million_font) + 25
    draw.text(((W - cw) / 2, child_y), child_text, font=children_font, fill=LIGHT_GRAY)

    # Breakdown bar
    bar_y = child_y + 90
    bar_left = MARGIN + 100
    bar_right = W - MARGIN - 100
    bar_total_w = bar_right - bar_left
    bar_h = 80

    primary_frac = 60 / 244
    secondary_frac = 184 / 244
    primary_w = int(bar_total_w * primary_frac)
    secondary_w = bar_total_w - primary_w

    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        [bar_left, bar_y, bar_left + primary_w - 4, bar_y + bar_h],
        radius=15, fill=(255, 140, 60)
    )
    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        [bar_left + primary_w + 4, bar_y, bar_right, bar_y + bar_h],
        radius=15, fill=CORAL
    )

    bar_label_font = font(32, bold=True)
    # Primary label
    p_text = "60M Primary"
    draw.text((bar_left + 20, bar_y + 24), p_text, font=bar_label_font, fill=WHITE)
    # Secondary label
    s_text = "184M Secondary"
    stw = text_width(draw, s_text, bar_label_font)
    draw.text((bar_left + primary_w + 4 + (secondary_w - stw) / 2, bar_y + 24),
              s_text, font=bar_label_font, fill=WHITE)

    y += hero_h + 60

    # ============================================================
    # SECTION 3: LEARNING CRISIS + QUALITY INEQUALITY (side by side)
    # ============================================================
    bottom_panel_h = 680
    bpanel_w = (CONTENT_W - 60) // 2
    lx = MARGIN
    rx = MARGIN + bpanel_w + 60

    # LEFT: Learning Crisis
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, [lx, y, lx + bpanel_w, y + bottom_panel_h], 30, BG_CARD)

    cy = y + 35
    cy = draw_section_label(draw, lx + 50, cy, "The Learning Crisis")
    cy += 10

    crisis_font = font(44, bold=False)
    lines = wrap_text(draw, "Being in school does not guarantee learning.", crisis_font, bpanel_w - 120)
    for line in lines:
        draw.text((lx + 50, cy), line, font=crisis_font, fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
        cy += text_height(draw, line, crisis_font) + 8
    cy += 20

    # Big stat: <20%
    pct_font = font(160, bold=True)
    draw.text((lx + 50, cy), "<20%", font=pct_font, fill=CORAL)
    cy += text_height(draw, "<20%", pct_font) + 15

    crisis_desc_font = font(38)
    desc_lines = wrap_text(draw,
        "of children in low-income countries achieve minimum reading proficiency by end of primary school",
        crisis_desc_font, bpanel_w - 120)
    for line in desc_lines:
        draw.text((lx + 50, cy), line, font=crisis_desc_font, fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
        cy += text_height(draw, line, crisis_desc_font) + 6

    # Waffle chart: 2 out of 10
    cy += 25
    cell_sz = 55
    gap = 12
    for i in range(10):
        cx_cell = lx + 50 + i * (cell_sz + gap)
        c = CORAL if i < 2 else (55, 65, 85)
        draw.rounded_rectangle(
            [cx_cell, cy, cx_cell + cell_sz, cy + cell_sz],
            radius=8, fill=c
        )
    # Label under waffle
    waffle_label_font = font(28)
    draw.text((lx + 50, cy + cell_sz + 12), "2 in 10 reach minimum reading level",
              font=waffle_label_font, fill=MID_GRAY)

    # RIGHT: Quality Inequality
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, [rx, y, rx + bpanel_w, y + bottom_panel_h], 30, BG_CARD)

    cy2 = y + 35
    cy2 = draw_section_label(draw, rx + 50, cy2, "A World Divided")
    cy2 += 10

    ineq_font = font(42, bold=False)
    lines = wrap_text(draw, "Learning-Adjusted Years of Schooling", ineq_font, bpanel_w - 120)
    for line in lines:
        draw.text((rx + 50, cy2), line, font=ineq_font, fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
        cy2 += text_height(draw, line, ineq_font) + 8
    cy2 += 30

    # Horizontal bars comparing years of schooling
    bar_max_w = bpanel_w - 160
    bar_labels = [
        ("Poorest Countries", 2.8, 10, CORAL),
        ("South Asia & SSA Avg", 6.5, 10, (255, 160, 80)),
        ("High-Income Countries", 10.5, 10.5, TEAL),
    ]

    bar_label_f = font(34, bold=True)
    bar_val_f = font(52, bold=True)
    bar_ht = 60
    bar_gap = 12

    max_val = 12
    for label, val, _, color in bar_labels:
        # Label
        draw.text((rx + 50, cy2), label, font=bar_label_f, fill=WHITE)
        cy2 += text_height(draw, label, bar_label_f) + 10

        # Bar
        bw = int((val / max_val) * bar_max_w)
        draw.rounded_rectangle(
            [rx + 50, cy2, rx + 50 + bw, cy2 + bar_ht],
            radius=12, fill=color
        )
        # Value at end
        val_text = f"<3 yrs" if val < 3 else (f"<7 yrs" if val < 7 else f"10+ yrs")
        draw.text((rx + 60, cy2 + 8), val_text, font=font(36, bold=True), fill=WHITE)
        cy2 += bar_ht + bar_gap + 15

    # Takeaway line
    cy2 += 10
    takeaway_lines = wrap_text(draw,
        "Children in the poorest countries receive less than a third of the quality schooling available in wealthy nations.",
        font(32), bpanel_w - 120)
    for line in takeaway_lines:
        draw.text((rx + 50, cy2), line, font=font(32), fill=MID_GRAY)
        cy2 += text_height(draw, line, font(32)) + 5

    y += bottom_panel_h + 60

    # ============================================================
    # SECTION 4: GENDER GAP (compact strip)
    # ============================================================
    gender_h = 250
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, [MARGIN, y, W - MARGIN, y + gender_h], 30, BG_CARD)

    gy = y + 30
    gy_start = draw_section_label(draw, MARGIN + 50, gy, "Closing the Gender Gap")

    # Three columns for Primary / Secondary / Tertiary
    col_w = (CONTENT_W - 160) // 3
    col_start = MARGIN + 60
    status_items = [
        ("Primary", "Nearly Closed", TEAL),
        ("Secondary", "Nearly Closed", TEAL),
        ("Tertiary", "Women Lead", AMBER),
    ]

    stat_y = gy_start + 15
    level_font = font(44, bold=True)
    status_font = font(36)

    for i, (level, status, color) in enumerate(status_items):
        cx = col_start + i * col_w
        draw.text((cx, stat_y), level, font=level_font, fill=WHITE)
        draw.text((cx, stat_y + 55), status, font=status_font, fill=color)

        # Checkmark or icon
        check_x = cx + text_width(draw, status, status_font) + 15
        check_y = stat_y + 55
        if color == TEAL:
            draw.text((check_x, check_y - 3), "✓", font=font(40, bold=True), fill=color)

    # Exception note
    note_font = font(30)
    note_text = "Exception: Significant gaps persist in countries like Afghanistan."
    nw = text_width(draw, note_text, note_font)
    draw.text((col_start, stat_y + 125), note_text, font=note_font, fill=MID_GRAY)

    y += gender_h + 60

    # ============================================================
    # SECTION 5: KEY TAKEAWAY
    # ============================================================
    takeaway_h = 280
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, [MARGIN, y, W - MARGIN, y + takeaway_h], 30, (40, 35, 25))
    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        [MARGIN, y, W - MARGIN, y + takeaway_h],
        radius=30, outline=AMBER, width=4
    )

    ty = y + 40
    key_font = font(48, bold=True)
    key_label = "KEY TAKEAWAY"
    klw = text_width(draw, key_label, key_font)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate A1 portrait poster: The State of Global Education."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math
import os

W, H = 3508, 4961

BG = (25, 32, 48)
BG_CARD = (35, 45, 65)
AMBER = (255, 179, 43)
CORAL = (255, 99, 72)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
LIGHT_GRAY = (180, 190, 210)
MID_GRAY = (120, 135, 160)
TEAL = (72, 199, 190)
OFF_BG = (55, 65, 85)

FONT_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"
FONT_REG = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"

_font_cache = {}

def font(size, bold=False):
    key = (size, bold)
    if key not in _font_cache:
        _font_cache[key] = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_BOLD if bold else FONT_REG, size)
    return _font_cache[key]

def tw(draw, text, f):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=f)
    return bbox[2] - bbox[0]

def th(draw, text, f):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=f)
    return bbox[3] - bbox[1]

def centered(draw, text, y, f, fill=WHITE):
    w = tw(draw, text, f)
    draw.text(((W - w) / 2, y), text, font=f, fill=fill)
    return y + th(draw, text, f)

def rrect(draw, xy, r, fill, outline=None, outline_w=0):
    draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=r, fill=fill)
    if outline:
        draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=r, outline=outline, width=outline_w)

def person_icon(draw, cx, cy, size, fill):
    hr = size * 0.18
    draw.ellipse([cx - hr, cy - size*0.45 - hr, cx + hr, cy - size*0.45 + hr], fill=fill)
    bt = cy - size*0.45 + hr + size*0.04
    bb = cy + size*0.45
    bw = size * 0.22
    draw.rounded_rectangle([cx - bw, bt, cx + bw, bb], radius=size*0.08, fill=fill)

def section_label(draw, x, y, text, fill=AMBER, size=50):
    f = font(size, bold=True)
    draw.text((x, y), text.upper(), font=f, fill=fill)
    ly = y + th(draw, text.upper(), f) + 12
    tw_ = tw(draw, text.upper(), f)
    draw.line([(x, ly), (x + tw_, ly)], fill=fill, width=5)
    return ly + 30

def wrap(draw, text, f, max_w):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = f"{cur} {w}".strip()
        if tw(draw, test, f) <= max_w:
            cur = test
        else:
            if cur: lines.append(cur)
            cur = w
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines


def main():
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    M = 160
    CW = W - 2 * M

    # Top accent bar
    draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, 14], fill=AMBER)
    y = 70

    # === TITLE ===
    y = centered(draw, "The State of Global Education", y, font(120, True)) + 15
    y = centered(draw, "Progress, Gaps, and Inequality", y, font(64), AMBER) + 25

    ol_font = font(42)
    for line in wrap(draw, "A comparative look at how far the world has come in expanding education access — and the critical gaps that remain.", ol_font, CW - 100):
        y = centered(draw, line, y, ol_font, LIGHT_GRAY) + 6
    y += 25
    draw.line([(M, y), (W - M, y)], fill=MID_GRAY, width=3)
    y += 45

    # === SECTION 1: TWO CENTURIES ===
    y = section_label(draw, M, y, "Two Centuries of Educational Expansion")

    pw = (CW - 80) // 2
    ph = 580
    lx, rx = M, M + pw + 80

    rrect(draw, [lx, y, lx + pw, y + ph], 30, BG_CARD)
    rrect(draw, [rx, y, rx + pw, y + ph], 30, BG_CARD)

    # 1800 panel
    draw.text((lx + 60, y + 35), "1800", font=font(56, True), fill=MID_GRAY)
    draw.text((lx + 60, y + 110), "<1 in 5", font=font(130, True), fill=CORAL)
    draw.text((lx + 60, y + 270), "adults had any formal", font=font(42), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    draw.text((lx + 60, y + 325), "education", font=font(42), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)

    iy = y + 420
    for i in range(10):
        ix = lx + 65 + i * 90
        person_icon(draw, ix + 30, iy + 45, 70, CORAL if i < 2 else OFF_BG)

    # TODAY panel
    draw.text((rx + 60, y + 35), "TODAY", font=font(56, True), fill=TEAL)
    draw.text((rx + 60, y + 110), ">4 in 5", font=font(130, True), fill=TEAL)
    draw.text((rx + 60, y + 270), "adults have received", font=font(42), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    draw.text((rx + 60, y + 325), "formal education", font=font(42), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)

    for i in range(10):
        ix = rx + 65 + i * 90
        person_icon(draw, ix + 30, iy + 45, 70, TEAL if i < 8 else OFF_BG)

    # Arrow
    acx = M + pw + 40
    acy = y + ph // 2
    draw.polygon([(acx - 28, acy - 28), (acx + 28, acy), (acx - 28, acy + 28)], fill=AMBER)

    y += ph + 65

    # === SECTION 2: 244 MILLION HERO ===
    hero_h = 820
    rrect(draw, [M - 50, y, W - M + 50, y + hero_h], 45, (50, 22, 22), CORAL, 7)

    hy = y + 50
    hy = centered(draw, "THE CHALLENGE THAT REMAINS", hy, font(54, True), CORAL) + 30

    # Giant 244
    gf = font(340, True)
    hy = centered(draw, "244", hy, gf, WHITE) + 5
    hy = centered(draw, "MILLION", hy, font(120, True), CORAL) + 15
    hy = centered(draw, "children of school age are not in school", hy, font(60), LIGHT_GRAY) + 50

    # Breakdown bar
    bleft = M + 120
    bright = W - M - 120
    btw = bright - bleft
    bh = 90
    p_w = int(btw * (60 / 244))
    s_w = btw - p_w

    draw.rounded_rectangle([bleft, hy, bleft + p_w - 5, hy + bh], radius=18, fill=(255, 140, 60))
    draw.rounded_rectangle([bleft + p_w + 5, hy, bright, hy + bh], radius=18, fill=CORAL)

    blf = font(36, True)
    draw.text((bleft + 25, hy + 25), "60M Primary", font=blf, fill=WHITE)
    st = "184M Secondary"
    stw_ = tw(draw, st, blf)
    draw.text((bleft + p_w + 5 + (s_w - stw_) / 2, hy + 25), st, font=blf, fill=WHITE)

    # Contextual note
    hy += bh + 35
    note = "Secondary-level dropout is the major driver — many who complete primary school do not continue."
    for line in wrap(draw, note, font(38), CW - 200):
        centered(draw, line, hy, font(38), MID_GRAY)
        hy += th(draw, line, font(38)) + 6

    y += hero_h + 65

    # === SECTION 3: LEARNING CRISIS + WORLD DIVIDED ===
    bp_h = 850
    bpw = (CW - 80) // 2
    lx2 = M
    rx2 = M + bpw + 80

    # Left: Learning Crisis
    rrect(draw, [lx2, y, lx2 + bpw, y + bp_h], 30, BG_CARD)

    cy = y + 40
    cy = section_label(draw, lx2 + 60, cy, "The Learning Crisis", size=46)

    for line in wrap(draw, "Being enrolled in school does not guarantee that children are actually learning.", font(44), bpw - 140):
        draw.text((lx2 + 60, cy), line, font=font(44), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
        cy += th(draw, line, font(44)) + 8
    cy += 30

    draw.text((lx2 + 60, cy), "<20%", font=font(200, True), fill=CORAL)
    cy += th(draw, "<20%", font(200, True)) + 20

    for line in wrap(draw, "of children in low-income countries achieve minimum reading proficiency by end of primary school", font(42), bpw - 140):
        draw.text((lx2 + 60, cy), line, font=font(42), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
        cy += th(draw, line, font(42)) + 8
    cy += 35

    # Waffle: 2 of 10
    csz, gp = 65, 14
    for i in range(10):
        cx = lx2 + 60 + i * (csz + gp)
        draw.rounded_rectangle([cx, cy, cx + csz, cy + csz], radius=10,
                               fill=CORAL if i < 2 else OFF_BG)
    draw.text((lx2 + 60, cy + csz + 16), "Only 2 in 10 reach minimum reading level",
              font=font(32), fill=MID_GRAY)

    # Right: World Divided
    rrect(draw, [rx2, y, rx2 + bpw, y + bp_h], 30, BG_CARD)

    cy2 = y + 40
    cy2 = section_label(draw, rx2 + 60, cy2, "A World Divided", size=46)

    for line in wrap(draw, "Learning-Adjusted Years of Schooling", font(44), bpw - 140):
        draw.text((rx2 + 60, cy2), line, font=font(44), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
        cy2 += th(draw, line, font(44)) + 8
    cy2 += 40

    bar_data = [
        ("Poorest Countries", 2.8, "<3 yrs", CORAL),
        ("South Asia & Sub-Saharan Africa", 6.5, "<7 yrs", (255, 160, 80)),
        ("High-Income Countries", 10.5, "10+ yrs", TEAL),
    ]
    bar_maxw = bpw - 180
    max_v = 12
    bar_ht = 75

    for label, val, val_txt, color in bar_data:
        draw.text((rx2 + 60, cy2), label, font=font(38, True), fill=WHITE)
        cy2 += th(draw, label, font(38, True)) + 14

        bw = int((val / max_v) * bar_maxw)
        draw.rounded_rectangle([rx2 + 60, cy2, rx2 + 60 + bw, cy2 + bar_ht],
                               radius=14, fill=color)
        draw.text((rx2 + 75, cy2 + 16), val_txt, font=font(40, True), fill=WHITE)
        cy2 += bar_ht + 30

    cy2 += 20

    # Bold comparison callout
    cmp_font = font(60, True)
    cmp1 = "<3 years"
    cmp2 = "10+ years"
    vs_font = font(44)
    total_cmp_w = tw(draw, cmp1, cmp_font) + tw(draw, "  vs  ", vs_font) + tw(draw, cmp2, cmp_font)
    cmp_x = rx2 + (bpw - total_cmp_w) // 2
    draw.text((cmp_x, cy2), cmp1, font=cmp_font, fill=CORAL)
    cmp_x += tw(draw, cmp1, cmp_font)
    draw.text((cmp_x, cy2 + 10), "  vs  ", font=vs_font, fill=MID_GRAY)
    cmp_x += tw(draw, "  vs  ", vs_font)
    draw.text((cmp_x, cy2), cmp2, font=cmp_font, fill=TEAL)
    cy2 += th(draw, cmp1, cmp_font) + 20

    for line in wrap(draw, "Children in the poorest nations receive less than a third of the quality schooling available in wealthy countries.", font(36), bpw - 140):
        draw.text((rx2 + 60, cy2), line, font=font(36), fill=MID_GRAY)
        cy2 += th(draw, line, font(36)) + 6

    y += bp_h + 65

    # === SECTION 4: GENDER GAP ===
    gh = 310
    rrect(draw, [M, y, W - M, y + gh], 30, BG_CARD)

    gy = y + 35
    gy = section_label(draw, M + 60, gy, "Closing the Gender Gap", size=46)

    col_w = (CW - 180) // 3
    col_x = M + 70
    items = [
        ("Primary", "Nearly Closed", TEAL, True),
        ("Secondary", "Nearly Closed", TEAL, True),
        ("Tertiary", "Women Now Lead", AMBER, False),
    ]

    for i, (level, status, color, check) in enumerate(items):
        cx = col_x + i * col_w
        draw.text((cx, gy + 10), level, font=font(50, True), fill=WHITE)
        draw.text((cx, gy + 72), status, font=font(40), fill=color)
        if check:
            ck_x = cx + tw(draw, status, font(40)) + 18
            draw.text((ck_x, gy + 68), "✓", font=font(44, True), fill=color)

    draw.text((col_x, gy + 145),
              "Exception: Significant gaps persist in countries like Afghanistan.",
              font=font(34), fill=MID_GRAY)

    y += gh + 65

    # === KEY TAKEAWAY ===
    tkh = 320
    rrect(draw, [M, y, W - M, y + tkh], 30, (40, 35, 25), AMBER, 5)

    ty = y + 45
    ty = centered(draw, "KEY TAKEAWAY", ty, font(54, True), AMBER) + 25

    tk_text = ("The world has achieved remarkable progress in education — but the job is far from done. "
               "Hundreds of millions of children are either out of school or learning very little while in it. "
               "Closing the gap between enrollment and actual learning is one of the most pressing challenges of our time.")
    for line in wrap(draw, tk_text, font(42), CW - 180):
        ty = centered(draw, line, ty, font(42), LIGHT_GRAY) + 8

    # === FOOTER ===
    fy = H - 100
    draw.line([(M, fy - 25), (W - M, fy - 25)], fill=MID_GRAY, width=2)
    ft = "Sources: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (2023) · World Bank Human Capital Index (2020) · Our World in Data"
    centered(draw, ft, fy, font(30), MID_GRAY)
    draw.rectangle([0, H - 14, W, H], fill=AMBER)

    os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
    img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", "PNG", dpi=(150, 150))
    print(f"Poster saved: {W}x{H} px")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    total_cmp_w = tw(draw, cmp1, cmp_font) + tw(draw, "  vs  ", vs_font) + tw(draw, cmp2, cmp_font)
    cmp_x = rx2 + (bpw - total_cmp_w) // 2
    draw.text((cmp_x, cy2), cmp1, font=cmp_font, fill=CORAL)
    cmp_x += tw(draw, cmp1, cmp_font)
    draw.text((cmp_x, cy2 + 10), "  vs  ", font=vs_font, fill=MID_GRAY)
    cmp_x += tw(draw, "  vs  ", vs_font)
    draw.text((cmp_x, cy2), cmp2, font=cmp_font, fill=TEAL)
    cy2 += th(draw, cmp1, cmp_font) + 20

    for line in wrap(draw, "Children in the poorest nations receive less than a third of the quality schooling available in wealthy countries.", font(36), bpw - 140):
        draw.text((rx2 + 60, cy2), line, font=font(36), fill=MID_GRAY)
        cy2 += th(draw, line, font(36)) + 6

    y += bp_h + 65

    # === SECTION 4: GENDER GAP ===
    gh = 310
    rrect(draw, [M, y, W - M, y + gh], 30, BG_CARD)

    gy = y + 35
    gy = section_label(draw, M + 60, gy, "Closing the Gender Gap", size=46)

    col_w = (CW - 180) // 3
    col_x = M + 70
    items = [
        ("Primary", "Nearly Closed", TEAL, True),
        ("Secondary", "Nearly Closed", TEAL, True),
        ("Tertiary", "Women Now Lead", AMBER, False),
    ]

    for i, (level, status, color, check) in enumerate(items):
        cx = col_x + i * col_w
        draw.text((cx, gy + 10), level, font=font(50, True), fill=WHITE)
        draw.text((cx, gy + 72), status, font=font(40), fill=color)
        if check:
            ck_x = cx + tw(draw, status, font(40)) + 18
            draw.text((ck_x, gy + 68), "✓", font=font(44, True), fill=color)

    draw.text((col_x, gy + 145),
              "Exception: Significant gaps persist in countries like Afghanistan.",
              font=font(34), fill=MID_GRAY)

    y += gh + 65

    # === KEY TAKEAWAY ===
    tkh = 320
    rrect(draw, [M, y, W - M, y + tkh], 30, (40, 35, 25), AMBER, 5)

    ty = y + 45
    ty = centered(draw, "KEY TAKEAWAY", ty, font(54, True), AMBER) + 25

    tk_text = ("The world has achieved remarkable progress in education — but the job is far from done. "
               "Hundreds of millions of children are either out of school or learning very little while in it. "
               "Closing the gap between enrollment and actual learning is one of the most pressing challenges of our time.")
    for line in wrap(draw, tk_text, font(42), CW - 180):
        ty = centered(draw, line, ty, font(42), LIGHT_GRAY) + 8

    # === FOOTER ===
    fy = H - 100
    draw.line([(M, fy - 25), (W - M, fy - 25)], fill=MID_GRAY, width=2)
    ft = "Sources: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (2023) · World Bank Human Capital Index (2020) · Our World in Data"
    centered(draw, ft, fy, font(30), MID_GRAY)
    draw.rectangle([0, H - 14, W, H], fill=AMBER)

    os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
    img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", "PNG", dpi=(150, 150))
    print(f"Poster saved: {W}x{H} px")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate A1 portrait poster: The State of Global Education."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math
import os

W, H = 3508, 4961

BG = (25, 32, 48)
BG_CARD = (35, 45, 65)
AMBER = (255, 179, 43)
CORAL = (255, 99, 72)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
LIGHT_GRAY = (180, 190, 210)
MID_GRAY = (120, 135, 160)
TEAL = (72, 199, 190)
OFF_BG = (55, 65, 85)

FONT_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"
FONT_REG = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"

_font_cache = {}

def font(size, bold=False):
    key = (size, bold)
    if key not in _font_cache:
        _font_cache[key] = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_BOLD if bold else FONT_REG, size)
    return _font_cache[key]

def tw(draw, text, f):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=f)
    return bbox[2] - bbox[0]

def th(draw, text, f):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=f)
    return bbox[3] - bbox[1]

def centered(draw, text, y, f, fill=WHITE):
    w = tw(draw, text, f)
    draw.text(((W - w) / 2, y), text, font=f, fill=fill)
    return y + th(draw, text, f)

def rrect(draw, xy, r, fill, outline=None, outline_w=0):
    draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=r, fill=fill)
    if outline:
        draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=r, outline=outline, width=outline_w)

def person_icon(draw, cx, cy, size, fill):
    hr = size * 0.18
    draw.ellipse([cx - hr, cy - size*0.45 - hr, cx + hr, cy - size*0.45 + hr], fill=fill)
    bt = cy - size*0.45 + hr + size*0.04
    bb = cy + size*0.45
    bw = size * 0.22
    draw.rounded_rectangle([cx - bw, bt, cx + bw, bb], radius=size*0.08, fill=fill)

def section_label(draw, x, y, text, fill=AMBER, size=50):
    f = font(size, bold=True)
    draw.text((x, y), text.upper(), font=f, fill=fill)
    ly = y + th(draw, text.upper(), f) + 12
    tw_ = tw(draw, text.upper(), f)
    draw.line([(x, ly), (x + tw_, ly)], fill=fill, width=5)
    return ly + 30

def wrap(draw, text, f, max_w):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = f"{cur} {w}".strip()
        if tw(draw, test, f) <= max_w:
            cur = test
        else:
            if cur: lines.append(cur)
            cur = w
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines


def main():
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    M = 160
    CW = W - 2 * M

    # Top accent bar
    draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, 14], fill=AMBER)
    y = 70

    # === TITLE ===
    y = centered(draw, "The State of Global Education", y, font(120, True)) + 15
    y = centered(draw, "Progress, Gaps, and Inequality", y, font(64), AMBER) + 25

    ol_font = font(42)
    for line in wrap(draw, "A comparative look at how far the world has come in expanding education access — and the critical gaps that remain.", ol_font, CW - 100):
        y = centered(draw, line, y, ol_font, LIGHT_GRAY) + 6
    y += 25
    draw.line([(M, y), (W - M, y)], fill=MID_GRAY, width=3)
    y += 45

    # === SECTION 1: TWO CENTURIES ===
    y = section_label(draw, M, y, "Two Centuries of Educational Expansion")

    pw = (CW - 80) // 2
    ph = 580
    lx, rx = M, M + pw + 80

    rrect(draw, [lx, y, lx + pw, y + ph], 30, BG_CARD)
    rrect(draw, [rx, y, rx + pw, y + ph], 30, BG_CARD)

    # 1800 panel
    draw.text((lx + 60, y + 35), "1800", font=font(56, True), fill=MID_GRAY)
    draw.text((lx + 60, y + 110), "<1 in 5", font=font(130, True), fill=CORAL)
    draw.text((lx + 60, y + 270), "adults had any formal", font=font(42), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    draw.text((lx + 60, y + 325), "education", font=font(42), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)

    iy = y + 420
    for i in range(10):
        ix = lx + 65 + i * 90
        person_icon(draw, ix + 30, iy + 45, 70, CORAL if i < 2 else OFF_BG)

    # TODAY panel
    draw.text((rx + 60, y + 35), "TODAY", font=font(56, True), fill=TEAL)
    draw.text((rx + 60, y + 110), ">4 in 5", font=font(130, True), fill=TEAL)
    draw.text((rx + 60, y + 270), "adults have received", font=font(42), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    draw.text((rx + 60, y + 325), "formal education", font=font(42), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)

    for i in range(10):
        ix = rx + 65 + i * 90
        person_icon(draw, ix + 30, iy + 45, 70, TEAL if i < 8 else OFF_BG)

    # Arrow
    acx = M + pw + 40
    acy = y + ph // 2
    draw.polygon([(acx - 28, acy - 28), (acx + 28, acy), (acx - 28, acy + 28)], fill=AMBER)

    y += ph + 65

    # === SECTION 2: 244 MILLION HERO ===
    hero_h = 820
    rrect(draw, [M - 50, y, W - M + 50, y + hero_h], 45, (50, 22, 22), CORAL, 7)

    hy = y + 50
    hy = centered(draw, "THE CHALLENGE THAT REMAINS", hy, font(54, True), CORAL) + 30

    # Giant 244
    gf = font(340, True)
    hy = centered(draw, "244", hy, gf, WHITE) + 5
    hy = centered(draw, "MILLION", hy, font(120, True), CORAL) + 15
    hy = centered(draw, "children of school age are not in school", hy, font(60), LIGHT_GRAY) + 50

    # Breakdown bar
    bleft = M + 120
    bright = W - M - 120
    btw = bright - bleft
    bh = 90
    p_w = int(btw * (60 / 244))
    s_w = btw - p_w

    draw.rounded_rectangle([bleft, hy, bleft + p_w - 5, hy + bh], radius=18, fill=(255, 140, 60))
    draw.rounded_rectangle([bleft + p_w + 5, hy, bright, hy + bh], radius=18, fill=CORAL)

    blf = font(36, True)
    draw.text((bleft + 25, hy + 25), "60M Primary", font=blf, fill=WHITE)
    st = "184M Secondary"
    stw_ = tw(draw, st, blf)
    draw.text((bleft + p_w + 5 + (s_w - stw_) / 2, hy + 25), st, font=blf, fill=WHITE)

    # Contextual note
    hy += bh + 35
    note = "Secondary-level dropout is the major driver — many who complete primary school do not continue."
    for line in wrap(draw, note, font(38), CW - 200):
        centered(draw, line, hy, font(38), MID_GRAY)
        hy += th(draw, line, font(38)) + 6

    y += hero_h + 65

    # === SECTION 3: LEARNING CRISIS + WORLD DIVIDED ===
    bp_h = 850
    bpw = (CW - 80) // 2
    lx2 = M
    rx2 = M + bpw + 80

    # Left: Learning Crisis
    rrect(draw, [lx2, y, lx2 + bpw, y + bp_h], 30, BG_CARD)

    cy = y + 40
    cy = section_label(draw, lx2 + 60, cy, "The Learning Crisis", size=46)

    for line in wrap(draw, "Being enrolled in school does not guarantee that children are actually learning.", font(44), bpw - 140):
        draw.text((lx2 + 60, cy), line, font=font(44), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
        cy += th(draw, line, font(44)) + 8
    cy += 30

    draw.text((lx2 + 60, cy), "<20%", font=font(200, True), fill=CORAL)
    cy += th(draw, "<20%", font(200, True)) + 20

    for line in wrap(draw, "of children in low-income countries achieve minimum reading proficiency by end of primary school", font(42), bpw - 140):
        draw.text((lx2 + 60, cy), line, font=font(42), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
        cy += th(draw, line, font(42)) + 8
    cy += 35

    # Waffle: 2 of 10
    csz, gp = 65, 14
    for i in range(10):
        cx = lx2 + 60 + i * (csz + gp)
        draw.rounded_rectangle([cx, cy, cx + csz, cy + csz], radius=10,
                               fill=CORAL if i < 2 else OFF_BG)
    draw.text((lx2 + 60, cy + csz + 16), "Only 2 in 10 reach minimum reading level",
              font=font(32), fill=MID_GRAY)

    # Right: World Divided
    rrect(draw, [rx2, y, rx2 + bpw, y + bp_h], 30, BG_CARD)

    cy2 = y + 40
    cy2 = section_label(draw, rx2 + 60, cy2, "A World Divided", size=46)

    for line in wrap(draw, "Learning-Adjusted Years of Schooling", font(44), bpw - 140):
        draw.text((rx2 + 60, cy2), line, font=font(44), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
        cy2 += th(draw, line, font(44)) + 8
    cy2 += 40

    bar_data = [
        ("Poorest Countries", 2.8, "<3 yrs", CORAL),
        ("South Asia & Sub-Saharan Africa", 6.5, "<7 yrs", (255, 160, 80)),
        ("High-Income Countries", 10.5, "10+ yrs", TEAL),
    ]
    bar_maxw = bpw - 180
    max_v = 12
    bar_ht = 75

    for label, val, val_txt, color in bar_data:
        draw.text((rx2 + 60, cy2), label, font=font(38, True), fill=WHITE)
        cy2 += th(draw, label, font(38, True)) + 14

        bw = int((val / max_v) * bar_maxw)
        draw.rounded_rectangle([rx2 + 60, cy2, rx2 + 60 + bw, cy2 + bar_ht],
                               radius=14, fill=color)
        draw.text((rx2 + 75, cy2 + 16), val_txt, font=font(40, True), fill=WHITE)
        cy2 += bar_ht + 30

    cy2 += 20

    # Bold comparison callout
    cmp_font = font(60, True)
    cmp1 = "<3 years"
    cmp2 = "10+ years"
    vs_font = font(44)
    total_cmp_w = tw(draw, cmp1, cmp_font) + tw(draw, "  vs  ", vs_font) + tw(draw, cmp2, cmp_font)
    cmp_x = rx2 + (bpw - total_cmp_w) // 2
    draw.text((cmp_x, cy2), cmp1, font=cmp_font, fill=CORAL)
    cmp_x += tw(draw, cmp1, cmp_font)
    draw.text((cmp_x, cy2 + 10), "  vs  ", font=vs_font, fill=MID_GRAY)
    cmp_x += tw(draw, "  vs  ", vs_font)
    draw.text((cmp_x, cy2), cmp2, font=cmp_font, fill=TEAL)
    cy2 += th(draw, cmp1, cmp_font) + 20

    for line in wrap(draw, "Children in the poorest nations receive less than a third of the quality schooling available in wealthy countries.", font(36), bpw - 140):
        draw.text((rx2 + 60, cy2), line, font=font(36), fill=MID_GRAY)
        cy2 += th(draw, line, font(36)) + 6

    y += bp_h + 65

    # === SECTION 4: GENDER GAP ===
    gh = 310
    rrect(draw, [M, y, W - M, y + gh], 30, BG_CARD)

    gy = y + 35
    gy = section_label(draw, M + 60, gy, "Closing the Gender Gap", size=46)

    col_w = (CW - 180) // 3
    col_x = M + 70
    items = [
        ("Primary", "Nearly Closed", TEAL, True),
        ("Secondary", "Nearly Closed", TEAL, True),
        ("Tertiary", "Women Now Lead", AMBER, False),
    ]

    for i, (level, status, color, check) in enumerate(items):
        cx = col_x + i * col_w
        draw.text((cx, gy + 10), level, font=font(50, True), fill=WHITE)
        draw.text((cx, gy + 72), status, font=font(40), fill=color)
        if check:
            ck_x = cx + tw(draw, status, font(40)) + 18
            draw.text((ck_x, gy + 68), "✓", font=font(44, True), fill=color)

    draw.text((col_x, gy + 145),
              "Exception: Significant gaps persist in countries like Afghanistan.",
              font=font(34), fill=MID_GRAY)

    y += gh + 65

    # === KEY TAKEAWAY ===
    tkh = 320
    rrect(draw, [M, y, W - M, y + tkh], 30, (40, 35, 25), AMBER, 5)

    ty = y + 45
    ty = centered(draw, "KEY TAKEAWAY", ty, font(54, True), AMBER) + 25

    tk_text = ("The world has achieved remarkable progress in education — but the job is far from done. "
               "Hundreds of millions of children are either out of school or learning very little while in it. "

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate A1 portrait poster: The State of Global Education."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math
import os

W, H = 3508, 4961

BG = (25, 32, 48)
BG_CARD = (35, 45, 65)
AMBER = (255, 179, 43)
CORAL = (255, 99, 72)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
LIGHT_GRAY = (180, 190, 210)
MID_GRAY = (120, 135, 160)
TEAL = (72, 199, 190)
OFF_BG = (55, 65, 85)

FONT_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"
FONT_REG = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"

_font_cache = {}

def font(size, bold=False):
    key = (size, bold)
    if key not in _font_cache:
        _font_cache[key] = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_BOLD if bold else FONT_REG, size)
    return _font_cache[key]

def tw(draw, text, f):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=f)
    return bbox[2] - bbox[0]

def th(draw, text, f):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=f)
    return bbox[3] - bbox[1]

def centered(draw, text, y, f, fill=WHITE):
    w = tw(draw, text, f)
    draw.text(((W - w) / 2, y), text, font=f, fill=fill)
    return y + th(draw, text, f)

def rrect(draw, xy, r, fill, outline=None, outline_w=0):
    draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=r, fill=fill)
    if outline:
        draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=r, outline=outline, width=outline_w)

def person_icon(draw, cx, cy, size, fill):
    hr = size * 0.18
    draw.ellipse([cx - hr, cy - size*0.45 - hr, cx + hr, cy - size*0.45 + hr], fill=fill)
    bt = cy - size*0.45 + hr + size*0.04
    bb = cy + size*0.45
    bw = size * 0.22
    draw.rounded_rectangle([cx - bw, bt, cx + bw, bb], radius=size*0.08, fill=fill)

def section_label(draw, x, y, text, fill=AMBER, size=50):
    f = font(size, bold=True)
    draw.text((x, y), text.upper(), font=f, fill=fill)
    ly = y + th(draw, text.upper(), f) + 12
    tw_ = tw(draw, text.upper(), f)
    draw.line([(x, ly), (x + tw_, ly)], fill=fill, width=5)
    return ly + 30

def wrap(draw, text, f, max_w):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = f"{cur} {w}".strip()
        if tw(draw, test, f) <= max_w:
            cur = test
        else:
            if cur: lines.append(cur)
            cur = w
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines


def main():
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    M = 160
    CW = W - 2 * M

    # Top accent bar
    draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, 14], fill=AMBER)
    y = 70

    # === TITLE ===
    y = centered(draw, "The State of Global Education", y, font(120, True)) + 15
    y = centered(draw, "Progress, Gaps, and Inequality", y, font(64), AMBER) + 25

    ol_font = font(42)
    for line in wrap(draw, "A comparative look at how far the world has come in expanding education access — and the critical gaps that remain.", ol_font, CW - 100):
        y = centered(draw, line, y, ol_font, LIGHT_GRAY) + 6
    y += 25
    draw.line([(M, y), (W - M, y)], fill=MID_GRAY, width=3)
    y += 45

    # === SECTION 1: TWO CENTURIES ===
    y = section_label(draw, M, y, "Two Centuries of Educational Expansion")

    pw = (CW - 80) // 2
    ph = 580
    lx, rx = M, M + pw + 80

    rrect(draw, [lx, y, lx + pw, y + ph], 30, BG_CARD)
    rrect(draw, [rx, y, rx + pw, y + ph], 30, BG_CARD)

    # 1800 panel
    draw.text((lx + 60, y + 35), "1800", font=font(56, True), fill=MID_GRAY)
    draw.text((lx + 60, y + 110), "<1 in 5", font=font(130, True), fill=CORAL)
    draw.text((lx + 60, y + 270), "adults had any formal", font=font(42), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    draw.text((lx + 60, y + 325), "education", font=font(42), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)

    iy = y + 420
    for i in range(10):
        ix = lx + 65 + i * 90
        person_icon(draw, ix + 30, iy + 45, 70, CORAL if i < 2 else OFF_BG)

    # TODAY panel
    draw.text((rx + 60, y + 35), "TODAY", font=font(56, True), fill=TEAL)
    draw.text((rx + 60, y + 110), ">4 in 5", font=font(130, True), fill=TEAL)
    draw.text((rx + 60, y + 270), "adults have received", font=font(42), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    draw.text((rx + 60, y + 325), "formal education", font=font(42), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)

    for i in range(10):
        ix = rx + 65 + i * 90
        person_icon(draw, ix + 30, iy + 45, 70, TEAL if i < 8 else OFF_BG)

    # Arrow
    acx = M + pw + 40
    acy = y + ph // 2
    draw.polygon([(acx - 28, acy - 28), (acx + 28, acy), (acx - 28, acy + 28)], fill=AMBER)

    y += ph + 65

    # === SECTION 2: 244 MILLION HERO ===
    hero_h = 820
    rrect(draw, [M - 50, y, W - M + 50, y + hero_h], 45, (50, 22, 22), CORAL, 7)

    hy = y + 50
    hy = centered(draw, "THE CHALLENGE THAT REMAINS", hy, font(54, True), CORAL) + 30

    # Giant 244
    gf = font(340, True)
    hy = centered(draw, "244", hy, gf, WHITE) + 5
    hy = centered(draw, "MILLION", hy, font(120, True), CORAL) + 15
    hy = centered(draw, "children of school age are not in school", hy, font(60), LIGHT_GRAY) + 50

    # Breakdown bar
    bleft = M + 120
    bright = W - M - 120
    btw = bright - bleft
    bh = 90
    p_w = int(btw * (60 / 244))
    s_w = btw - p_w

    draw.rounded_rectangle([bleft, hy, bleft + p_w - 5, hy + bh], radius=18, fill=(255, 140, 60))
    draw.rounded_rectangle([bleft + p_w + 5, hy, bright, hy + bh], radius=18, fill=CORAL)

    blf = font(36, True)
    draw.text((bleft + 25, hy + 25), "60M Primary", font=blf, fill=WHITE)
    st = "184M Secondary"
    stw_ = tw(draw, st, blf)
    draw.text((bleft + p_w + 5 + (s_w - stw_) / 2, hy + 25), st, font=blf, fill=WHITE)

    # Contextual note
    hy += bh + 35
    note = "Secondary-level dropout is the major driver — many who complete primary school do not continue."
    for line in wrap(draw, note, font(38), CW - 200):
        centered(draw, line, hy, font(38), MID_GRAY)
        hy += th(draw, line, font(38)) + 6

    y += hero_h + 65

    # === SECTION 3: LEARNING CRISIS + WORLD DIVIDED ===
    bp_h = 850
    bpw = (CW - 80) // 2
    lx2 = M
    rx2 = M + bpw + 80

    # Left: Learning Crisis
    rrect(draw, [lx2, y, lx2 + bpw, y + bp_h], 30, BG_CARD)

    cy = y + 40
    cy = section_label(draw, lx2 + 60, cy, "The Learning Crisis", size=46)

    for line in wrap(draw, "Being enrolled in school does not guarantee that children are actually learning.", font(44), bpw - 140):
        draw.text((lx2 + 60, cy), line, font=font(44), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
        cy += th(draw, line, font(44)) + 8
    cy += 30

    draw.text((lx2 + 60, cy), "<20%", font=font(200, True), fill=CORAL)
    cy += th(draw, "<20%", font(200, True)) + 20

    for line in wrap(draw, "of children in low-income countries achieve minimum reading proficiency by end of primary school", font(42), bpw - 140):
        draw.text((lx2 + 60, cy), line, font=font(42), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
        cy += th(draw, line, font(42)) + 8
    cy += 35

    # Waffle: 2 of 10
    csz, gp = 65, 14
    for i in range(10):
        cx = lx2 + 60 + i * (csz + gp)
        draw.rounded_rectangle([cx, cy, cx + csz, cy + csz], radius=10,
                               fill=CORAL if i < 2 else OFF_BG)
    draw.text((lx2 + 60, cy + csz + 16), "Only 2 in 10 reach minimum reading level",
              font=font(32), fill=MID_GRAY)

    # Right: World Divided
    rrect(draw, [rx2, y, rx2 + bpw, y + bp_h], 30, BG_CARD)

    cy2 = y + 40
    cy2 = section_label(draw, rx2 + 60, cy2, "A World Divided", size=46)

    for line in wrap(draw, "Learning-Adjusted Years of Schooling", font(44), bpw - 140):
        draw.text((rx2 + 60, cy2), line, font=font(44), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
        cy2 += th(draw, line, font(44)) + 8
    cy2 += 40

    bar_data = [
        ("Poorest Countries", 2.8, "<3 yrs", CORAL),
        ("South Asia & Sub-Saharan Africa", 6.5, "<7 yrs", (255, 160, 80)),
        ("High-Income Countries", 10.5, "10+ yrs", TEAL),
    ]
    bar_maxw = bpw - 180
    max_v = 12
    bar_ht = 75

    for label, val, val_txt, color in bar_data:
        draw.text((rx2 + 60, cy2), label, font=font(38, True), fill=WHITE)
        cy2 += th(draw, label, font(38, True)) + 14

        bw = int((val / max_v) * bar_maxw)
        draw.rounded_rectangle([rx2 + 60, cy2, rx2 + 60 + bw, cy2 + bar_ht],
                               radius=14, fill=color)
        draw.text((rx2 + 75, cy2 + 16), val_txt, font=font(40, True), fill=WHITE)
        cy2 += bar_ht + 30

    cy2 += 20

    # Bold comparison callout
    cmp_font = font(60, True)
    cmp1 = "<3 years"
    cmp2 = "10+ years"
    vs_font = font(44)
    total_cmp_w = tw(draw, cmp1, cmp_font) + tw(draw, "  vs  ", vs_font) + tw(draw, cmp2, cmp_font)
    cmp_x = rx2 + (bpw - total_cmp_w) // 2
    draw.text((cmp_x, cy2), cmp1, font=cmp_font, fill=CORAL)
    cmp_x += tw(draw, cmp1, cmp_font)
    draw.text((cmp_x, cy2 + 10), "  vs  ", font=vs_font, fill=MID_GRAY)
    cmp_x += tw(draw, "  vs  ", vs_font)
    draw.text((cmp_x, cy2), cmp2, font=cmp_font, fill=TEAL)
    cy2 += th(draw, cmp1, cmp_font) + 20

    for line in wrap(draw, "Children in the poorest nations receive less than a third of the quality schooling available in wealthy countries.", font(36), bpw - 140):
        draw.text((rx2 + 60, cy2), line, font=font(36), fill=MID_GRAY)
        cy2 += th(draw, line, font(36)) + 6

    y += bp_h + 65

    # === SECTION 4: GENDER GAP ===
    gh = 310
    rrect(draw, [M, y, W - M, y + gh], 30, BG_CARD)

    gy = y + 35
    gy = section_label(draw, M + 60, gy, "Closing the Gender Gap", size=46)

    col_w = (CW - 180) // 3
    col_x = M + 70
    items = [
        ("Primary", "Nearly Closed", TEAL, True),
        ("Secondary", "Nearly Closed", TEAL, True),
        ("Tertiary", "Women Now Lead", AMBER, False),
    ]

    for i, (level, status, color, check) in enumerate(items):
        cx = col_x + i * col_w
        draw.text((cx, gy + 10), level, font=font(50, True), fill=WHITE)
        draw.text((cx, gy + 72), status, font=font(40), fill=color)
        if check:
            ck_x = cx + tw(draw, status, font(40)) + 18
            draw.text((ck_x, gy + 68), "✓", font=font(44, True), fill=color)

    draw.text((col_x, gy + 145),
              "Exception: Significant gaps persist in countries like Afghanistan.",
              font=font(34), fill=MID_GRAY)

    y += gh + 65

    # === KEY TAKEAWAY ===
    tkh = 320
    rrect(draw, [M, y, W - M, y + tkh], 30, (40, 35, 25), AMBER, 5)

    ty = y + 45
    ty = centered(draw, "KEY TAKEAWAY", ty, font(54, True), AMBER) + 25

    tk_text = ("The world has achieved remarkable progress in education — but the job is far from done. "
               "Hundreds of millions of children are either out of school or learning very little while in it. "
               "Closing the gap between enrollment and actual learning is one of the most pressing challenges of our time.")
    for line in wrap(draw, tk_text, font(42), CW - 180):
