#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate A1 portrait poster: The State of Global Education."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math
import os

W, H = 3508, 4961

BG = (25, 32, 48)
BG_CARD = (35, 45, 65)
AMBER = (255, 179, 43)
CORAL = (255, 99, 72)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
LIGHT_GRAY = (180, 190, 210)
MID_GRAY = (120, 135, 160)
TEAL = (72, 199, 190)
OFF_BG = (55, 65, 85)

FONT_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"
FONT_REG = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"

_font_cache = {}

def font(size, bold=False):
    key = (size, bold)
    if key not in _font_cache:
        _font_cache[key] = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_BOLD if bold else FONT_REG, size)
    return _font_cache[key]

def tw(draw, text, f):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=f)
    return bbox[2] - bbox[0]

def th(draw, text, f):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=f)
    return bbox[3] - bbox[1]

def centered(draw, text, y, f, fill=WHITE):
    w = tw(draw, text, f)
    draw.text(((W - w) / 2, y), text, font=f, fill=fill)
    return y + th(draw, text, f)

def rrect(draw, xy, r, fill, outline=None, outline_w=0):
    draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=r, fill=fill)
    if outline:
        draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=r, outline=outline, width=outline_w)

def person_icon(draw, cx, cy, size, fill):
    hr = size * 0.18
    draw.ellipse([cx - hr, cy - size*0.45 - hr, cx + hr, cy - size*0.45 + hr], fill=fill)
    bt = cy - size*0.45 + hr + size*0.04
    bb = cy + size*0.45
    bw = size * 0.22
    draw.rounded_rectangle([cx - bw, bt, cx + bw, bb], radius=size*0.08, fill=fill)

def section_label(draw, x, y, text, fill=AMBER, size=50):
    f = font(size, bold=True)
    draw.text((x, y), text.upper(), font=f, fill=fill)
    ly = y + th(draw, text.upper(), f) + 12
    tw_ = tw(draw, text.upper(), f)
    draw.line([(x, ly), (x + tw_, ly)], fill=fill, width=5)
    return ly + 30

def wrap(draw, text, f, max_w):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = f"{cur} {w}".strip()
        if tw(draw, test, f) <= max_w:
            cur = test
        else:
            if cur: lines.append(cur)
            cur = w
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines


def main():
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    M = 160
    CW = W - 2 * M

    # Top accent bar
    draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, 14], fill=AMBER)
    y = 70

    # === TITLE ===
    y = centered(draw, "The State of Global Education", y, font(120, True)) + 15
    y = centered(draw, "Progress, Gaps, and Inequality", y, font(64), AMBER) + 25

    ol_font = font(42)
    for line in wrap(draw, "A comparative look at how far the world has come in expanding education access — and the critical gaps that remain.", ol_font, CW - 100):
        y = centered(draw, line, y, ol_font, LIGHT_GRAY) + 6
    y += 25
    draw.line([(M, y), (W - M, y)], fill=MID_GRAY, width=3)
    y += 45

    # === SECTION 1: TWO CENTURIES ===
    y = section_label(draw, M, y, "Two Centuries of Educational Expansion")

    pw = (CW - 80) // 2
    ph = 580
    lx, rx = M, M + pw + 80

    rrect(draw, [lx, y, lx + pw, y + ph], 30, BG_CARD)
    rrect(draw, [rx, y, rx + pw, y + ph], 30, BG_CARD)

    # 1800 panel
    draw.text((lx + 60, y + 35), "1800", font=font(56, True), fill=MID_GRAY)
    draw.text((lx + 60, y + 110), "<1 in 5", font=font(130, True), fill=CORAL)
    draw.text((lx + 60, y + 270), "adults had any formal", font=font(42), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    draw.text((lx + 60, y + 325), "education", font=font(42), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)

    iy = y + 420
    for i in range(10):
        ix = lx + 65 + i * 90
        person_icon(draw, ix + 30, iy + 45, 70, CORAL if i < 2 else OFF_BG)

    # TODAY panel
    draw.text((rx + 60, y + 35), "TODAY", font=font(56, True), fill=TEAL)
    draw.text((rx + 60, y + 110), ">4 in 5", font=font(130, True), fill=TEAL)
    draw.text((rx + 60, y + 270), "adults have received", font=font(42), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    draw.text((rx + 60, y + 325), "formal education", font=font(42), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)

    for i in range(10):
        ix = rx + 65 + i * 90
        person_icon(draw, ix + 30, iy + 45, 70, TEAL if i < 8 else OFF_BG)

    # Arrow
    acx = M + pw + 40
    acy = y + ph // 2
    draw.polygon([(acx - 28, acy - 28), (acx + 28, acy), (acx - 28, acy + 28)], fill=AMBER)

    y += ph + 65

    # === SECTION 2: 244 MILLION HERO ===
    hero_h = 820
    rrect(draw, [M - 50, y, W - M + 50, y + hero_h], 45, (50, 22, 22), CORAL, 7)

    hy = y + 50
    hy = centered(draw, "THE CHALLENGE THAT REMAINS", hy, font(54, True), CORAL) + 30

    # Giant 244
    gf = font(340, True)
    hy = centered(draw, "244", hy, gf, WHITE) + 5
    hy = centered(draw, "MILLION", hy, font(120, True), CORAL) + 15
    hy = centered(draw, "children of school age are not in school", hy, font(60), LIGHT_GRAY) + 50

    # Breakdown bar
    bleft = M + 120
    bright = W - M - 120
    btw = bright - bleft
    bh = 90
    p_w = int(btw * (60 / 244))
    s_w = btw - p_w

    draw.rounded_rectangle([bleft, hy, bleft + p_w - 5, hy + bh], radius=18, fill=(255, 140, 60))
    draw.rounded_rectangle([bleft + p_w + 5, hy, bright, hy + bh], radius=18, fill=CORAL)

    blf = font(36, True)
    draw.text((bleft + 25, hy + 25), "60M Primary", font=blf, fill=WHITE)
    st = "184M Secondary"
    stw_ = tw(draw, st, blf)
    draw.text((bleft + p_w + 5 + (s_w - stw_) / 2, hy + 25), st, font=blf, fill=WHITE)

    # Contextual note
    hy += bh + 35
    note = "Secondary-level dropout is the major driver — many who complete primary school do not continue."
    for line in wrap(draw, note, font(38), CW - 200):
        centered(draw, line, hy, font(38), MID_GRAY)
        hy += th(draw, line, font(38)) + 6

    y += hero_h + 65

    # === SECTION 3: LEARNING CRISIS + WORLD DIVIDED ===
    bp_h = 850
    bpw = (CW - 80) // 2
    lx2 = M
    rx2 = M + bpw + 80

    # Left: Learning Crisis
    rrect(draw, [lx2, y, lx2 + bpw, y + bp_h], 30, BG_CARD)

    cy = y + 40
    cy = section_label(draw, lx2 + 60, cy, "The Learning Crisis", size=46)

    for line in wrap(draw, "Being enrolled in school does not guarantee that children are actually learning.", font(44), bpw - 140):
        draw.text((lx2 + 60, cy), line, font=font(44), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
        cy += th(draw, line, font(44)) + 8
    cy += 30

    draw.text((lx2 + 60, cy), "<20%", font=font(200, True), fill=CORAL)
    cy += th(draw, "<20%", font(200, True)) + 20

    for line in wrap(draw, "of children in low-income countries achieve minimum reading proficiency by end of primary school", font(42), bpw - 140):
        draw.text((lx2 + 60, cy), line, font=font(42), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
        cy += th(draw, line, font(42)) + 8
    cy += 35

    # Waffle: 2 of 10
    csz, gp = 65, 14
    for i in range(10):
        cx = lx2 + 60 + i * (csz + gp)
        draw.rounded_rectangle([cx, cy, cx + csz, cy + csz], radius=10,
                               fill=CORAL if i < 2 else OFF_BG)
    draw.text((lx2 + 60, cy + csz + 16), "Only 2 in 10 reach minimum reading level",
              font=font(32), fill=MID_GRAY)

    # Right: World Divided
    rrect(draw, [rx2, y, rx2 + bpw, y + bp_h], 30, BG_CARD)

    cy2 = y + 40
    cy2 = section_label(draw, rx2 + 60, cy2, "A World Divided", size=46)

    for line in wrap(draw, "Learning-Adjusted Years of Schooling", font(44), bpw - 140):
        draw.text((rx2 + 60, cy2), line, font=font(44), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
        cy2 += th(draw, line, font(44)) + 8
    cy2 += 40

    bar_data = [
        ("Poorest Countries", 2.8, "<3 yrs", CORAL),
        ("South Asia & Sub-Saharan Africa", 6.5, "<7 yrs", (255, 160, 80)),
        ("High-Income Countries", 10.5, "10+ yrs", TEAL),
    ]
    bar_maxw = bpw - 180
    max_v = 12
    bar_ht = 75

    for label, val, val_txt, color in bar_data:
        draw.text((rx2 + 60, cy2), label, font=font(38, True), fill=WHITE)
        cy2 += th(draw, label, font(38, True)) + 14

        bw = int((val / max_v) * bar_maxw)
        draw.rounded_rectangle([rx2 + 60, cy2, rx2 + 60 + bw, cy2 + bar_ht],
                               radius=14, fill=color)
        draw.text((rx2 + 75, cy2 + 16), val_txt, font=font(40, True), fill=WHITE)
        cy2 += bar_ht + 30

    cy2 += 20

    # Bold comparison callout
    cmp_font = font(60, True)
    cmp1 = "<3 years"
    cmp2 = "10+ years"
    vs_font = font(44)
    total_cmp_w = tw(draw, cmp1, cmp_font) + tw(draw, "  vs  ", vs_font) + tw(draw, cmp2, cmp_font)
    cmp_x = rx2 + (bpw - total_cmp_w) // 2
    draw.text((cmp_x, cy2), cmp1, font=cmp_font, fill=CORAL)
    cmp_x += tw(draw, cmp1, cmp_font)
    draw.text((cmp_x, cy2 + 10), "  vs  ", font=vs_font, fill=MID_GRAY)
    cmp_x += tw(draw, "  vs  ", vs_font)
    draw.text((cmp_x, cy2), cmp2, font=cmp_font, fill=TEAL)
    cy2 += th(draw, cmp1, cmp_font) + 20

    for line in wrap(draw, "Children in the poorest nations receive less than a third of the quality schooling available in wealthy countries.", font(36), bpw - 140):
        draw.text((rx2 + 60, cy2), line, font=font(36), fill=MID_GRAY)
        cy2 += th(draw, line, font(36)) + 6

    y += bp_h + 65

    # === SECTION 4: GENDER GAP ===
    gh = 310
    rrect(draw, [M, y, W - M, y + gh], 30, BG_CARD)

    gy = y + 35
    gy = section_label(draw, M + 60, gy, "Closing the Gender Gap", size=46)

    col_w = (CW - 180) // 3
    col_x = M + 70
    items = [
        ("Primary", "Nearly Closed", TEAL, True),
        ("Secondary", "Nearly Closed", TEAL, True),
        ("Tertiary", "Women Now Lead", AMBER, False),
    ]

    for i, (level, status, color, check) in enumerate(items):
        cx = col_x + i * col_w
        draw.text((cx, gy + 10), level, font=font(50, True), fill=WHITE)
        draw.text((cx, gy + 72), status, font=font(40), fill=color)
        if check:
            ck_x = cx + tw(draw, status, font(40)) + 18
            draw.text((ck_x, gy + 68), "✓", font=font(44, True), fill=color)

    draw.text((col_x, gy + 145),
              "Exception: Significant gaps persist in countries like Afghanistan.",
              font=font(34), fill=MID_GRAY)

    y += gh + 65

    # === KEY TAKEAWAY ===
    tkh = 320
    rrect(draw, [M, y, W - M, y + tkh], 30, (40, 35, 25), AMBER, 5)

    ty = y + 45
    ty = centered(draw, "KEY TAKEAWAY", ty, font(54, True), AMBER) + 25

    tk_text = ("The world has achieved remarkable progress in education — but the job is far from done. "
               "Hundreds of millions of children are either out of school or learning very little while in it. "
               "Closing the gap between enrollment and actual learning is one of the most pressing challenges of our time.")
    for line in wrap(draw, tk_text, font(42), CW - 180):
        ty = centered(draw, line, ty, font(42), LIGHT_GRAY) + 8

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate A1 portrait poster: The State of Global Education."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os

W, H = 3508, 4961

BG = (25, 32, 48)
BG_CARD = (35, 45, 65)
AMBER = (255, 179, 43)
CORAL = (255, 99, 72)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
LIGHT_GRAY = (180, 190, 210)
MID_GRAY = (120, 135, 160)
TEAL = (72, 199, 190)
OFF_BG = (55, 65, 85)
HERO_BG = (50, 22, 22)
TK_BG = (40, 35, 25)

FONT_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"
FONT_REG = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"

_fc = {}
def F(size, bold=False):
    k = (size, bold)
    if k not in _fc:
        _fc[k] = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_BOLD if bold else FONT_REG, size)
    return _fc[k]

def tw(d, t, f):
    b = d.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f)
    return b[2] - b[0]

def th(d, t, f):
    b = d.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f)
    return b[3] - b[1]

def ctr(d, t, y, f, c=WHITE):
    d.text(((W - tw(d, t, f)) / 2, y), t, font=f, fill=c)
    return y + th(d, t, f)

def rr(d, xy, r, fill, ol=None, ow=0):
    d.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=r, fill=fill)
    if ol:
        d.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=r, outline=ol, width=ow)

def person(d, cx, cy, sz, fill):
    hr = sz * 0.18
    d.ellipse([cx-hr, cy-sz*0.45-hr, cx+hr, cy-sz*0.45+hr], fill=fill)
    bt = cy - sz*0.45 + hr + sz*0.04
    bb = cy + sz*0.45
    bw = sz * 0.22
    d.rounded_rectangle([cx-bw, bt, cx+bw, bb], radius=sz*0.08, fill=fill)

def slabel(d, x, y, text, fill=AMBER, sz=50):
    f = F(sz, True)
    t = text.upper()
    d.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=fill)
    ly = y + th(d, t, f) + 12
    d.line([(x, ly), (x + tw(d, t, f), ly)], fill=fill, width=5)
    return ly + 30

def wrap(d, text, f, mw):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = f"{cur} {w}".strip()
        if tw(d, test, f) <= mw:
            cur = test
        else:
            if cur: lines.append(cur)
            cur = w
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines

    for line in wrap(d, text, f, mw):
        y = ctr(d, line, y, f, c) + 6
    return y

def draw_lines_left(d, text, x, y, f, mw, c=WHITE):
    for line in wrap(d, text, f, mw):
        d.text((x, y), line, font=f, fill=c)
        y += th(d, line, f) + 8

    CW = W - 2 * M

    y = ctr(d, "The State of Global Education", y, F(120, True)) + 12
    y = ctr(d, "Progress, Gaps, and Inequality", y, F(64), AMBER) + 22
    y = draw_lines_centered(d,
        "A comparative look at how far the world has come in expanding education access — and the critical gaps that remain.",

    d.line([(M, y), (W - M, y)], fill=MID_GRAY, width=3)

    ph = 620
    lx, rx = M, M + pw + 80

    rr(d, [lx, y, lx+pw, y+ph], 30, BG_CARD)
    rr(d, [rx, y, rx+pw, y+ph], 30, BG_CARD)

    d.text((lx+60, y+295), "adults had any formal", font=F(44), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    d.text((lx+60, y+350), "education", font=F(44), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    for i in range(10):

    # TODAY

    d.text((rx+60, y+120), ">4 in 5", font=F(140, True), fill=TEAL)
    d.text((rx+60, y+295), "adults have received", font=F(44), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    d.text((rx+60, y+350), "formal education", font=F(44), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    for i in range(10):
        person(d, rx+80+i*95, y+490, 75, TEAL if i < 8 else OFF_BG)

    # Arrow
    acx = M + pw + 40
    acy = y + ph // 2
    d.polygon([(acx-30, acy-30), (acx+30, acy), (acx-30, acy+30)], fill=AMBER)

    y += ph + 70

    # ── SECTION 2: 244 MILLION HERO ──
    hh = 900
    rr(d, [M-50, y, W-M+50, y+hh], 45, HERO_BG, CORAL, 7)

    hy = ctr(d, "children of school age are not in school", hy, F(62), LIGHT_GRAY) + 55

    br = W - M - 140
    btw = br - bl
    bh = 100

    st = "184M Secondary"
    d.text((bl+p_w+5+(s_w-tw(d,st,F(38,True)))//2, hy+28), st, font=F(38, True), fill=WHITE)

    hy += bh + 40
    hy = draw_lines_centered(d,
        "Secondary-level dropout is the major driver — many who complete primary school do not continue.",
        hy, F(40), CW - 200, MID_GRAY)

    y += hh + 70

    # ── SECTION 3: LEARNING CRISIS + WORLD DIVIDED ──
    bph = 950
    bpw = (CW - 80) // 2
    lx2, rx2 = M, M + bpw + 80

    # LEFT: Learning Crisis
    rr(d, [lx2, y, lx2+bpw, y+bph], 30, BG_CARD)
    cy = y + 45
    cy = slabel(d, lx2+60, cy, "The Learning Crisis", sz=48)
    cy = draw_lines_left(d,
        "Being enrolled in school does not guarantee that children are actually learning.",
        lx2+60, cy, F(46), bpw-140, LIGHT_GRAY) + 30

    d.text((lx2+60, cy), "<20%", font=F(220, True), fill=CORAL)
    cy += th(d, "<20%", F(220, True)) + 25

    cy = draw_lines_left(d,
        "of children in low-income countries achieve minimum reading proficiency by end of primary school",
        lx2+60, cy, F(44), bpw-140, LIGHT_GRAY) + 40

    # Waffle
    csz, gp = 70, 16
    for i in range(10):
        cx = lx2 + 60 + i * (csz + gp)
        d.rounded_rectangle([cx, cy, cx+csz, cy+csz], radius=12,
                            fill=CORAL if i < 2 else OFF_BG)
    d.text((lx2+60, cy+csz+18), "Only 2 in 10 reach minimum reading level",
           font=F(34), fill=MID_GRAY)

    # RIGHT: World Divided
    rr(d, [rx2, y, rx2+bpw, y+bph], 30, BG_CARD)
    cy2 = y + 45
    cy2 = slabel(d, rx2+60, cy2, "A World Divided", sz=48)
    cy2 = draw_lines_left(d, "Learning-Adjusted Years of Schooling",
                          rx2+60, cy2, F(46), bpw-140, LIGHT_GRAY) + 40

    bars = [
        ("Poorest Countries", 2.8, "<3 yrs", CORAL),
        ("South Asia & Sub-Saharan Africa", 6.5, "<7 yrs", (255, 160, 80)),
        ("High-Income Countries", 10.5, "10+ yrs", TEAL),
    ]
    bmw = bpw - 200
    for label, val, vt, color in bars:
        d.text((rx2+60, cy2), label, font=F(40, True), fill=WHITE)
        cy2 += th(d, label, F(40, True)) + 16
        bw = int((val / 12) * bmw)
        d.rounded_rectangle([rx2+60, cy2, rx2+60+bw, cy2+80], radius=16, fill=color)
        d.text((rx2+78, cy2+18), vt, font=F(42, True), fill=WHITE)
        cy2 += 80 + 35

    cy2 += 25
    # Bold comparison
    cf = F(68, True)
    vf = F(48)
    c1, c2 = "<3 years", "10+ years"
    vs = "  vs  "
    total = tw(d, c1, cf) + tw(d, vs, vf) + tw(d, c2, cf)

    cx += tw(d, vs, vf)
    d.text((cx, cy2), c2, font=cf, fill=TEAL)
    cy2 += th(d, c1, cf) + 25

    cy2 = draw_lines_left(d,

    gh = 340

    gy = slabel(d, M+60, gy, "Closing the Gender Gap", sz=48)

    d.line([(M, fy-25), (W-M, fy-25)], fill=MID_GRAY, width=2)
    ctr(d, "Sources: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (2023) · World Bank Human Capital Index (2020) · Our World in Data",
        fy, F(32), MID_GRAY)
    d.rectangle([0, H-14, W, H], fill=AMBER)

    os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
    img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", "PNG", dpi=(150, 150))
    print(f"Poster saved: {W}x{H}")

    d.text((cx, cy2), c1, font=cf, fill=CORAL)

    d.text((cx, cy2), c2, font=cf, fill=TEAL)

        ("Secondary", "Nearly Closed", TEAL, True),
        ("Tertiary", "Women Now Lead", AMBER, False),

    for i, (level, status, color, check) in enumerate(items):
        cx = col_x + i * col_w
        d.text((cx, gy+10), level, font=F(54, True), fill=WHITE)
        d.text((cx, gy+78), status, font=F(44), fill=color)
        if check:
            ck = cx + tw(d, status, F(44)) + 20
            d.text((ck, gy+74), "✓", font=F(48, True), fill=color)

    d.text((col_x, gy+160),

           font=F(36), fill=MID_GRAY)

    y += gh + 70

    # ── KEY TAKEAWAY ──

    rr(d, [M, y, W-M, y+tkh], 30, TK_BG, AMBER, 5)
    ty = y + 50
    ty = ctr(d, "KEY TAKEAWAY", ty, F(58, True), AMBER) + 30
    ty = draw_lines_centered(d,
        "The world has achieved remarkable progress in education — but the job is far from done. "
        "Hundreds of millions of children are either out of school or learning very little while in it. "
        "Closing the gap between enrollment and actual learning is one of the most pressing challenges of our time.",
        ty, F(44), CW - 200, LIGHT_GRAY)

    # ── FOOTER ──
    fy = H - 100
    d.line([(M, fy-25), (W-M, fy-25)], fill=MID_GRAY, width=2)
    ctr(d, "Sources: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (2023) · World Bank Human Capital Index (2020) · Our World in Data",
        fy, F(32), MID_GRAY)
    d.rectangle([0, H-14, W, H], fill=AMBER)

    img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", "PNG", dpi=(150, 150))
    print(f"Poster saved: {W}x{H}")

    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate A1 portrait poster: The State of Global Education."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os

W, H = 3508, 4961

BG = (25, 32, 48)
BG_CARD = (35, 45, 65)
AMBER = (255, 179, 43)
CORAL = (255, 99, 72)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
LIGHT_GRAY = (180, 190, 210)
MID_GRAY = (120, 135, 160)
TEAL = (72, 199, 190)
OFF_BG = (55, 65, 85)
HERO_BG = (50, 22, 22)
TK_BG = (40, 35, 25)

FONT_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"
FONT_REG = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"

_fc = {}
def F(size, bold=False):
    k = (size, bold)
    if k not in _fc:
        _fc[k] = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_BOLD if bold else FONT_REG, size)
    return _fc[k]

def tw(d, t, f):
    b = d.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f)
    return b[2] - b[0]

def th(d, t, f):
    b = d.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f)
    return b[3] - b[1]

def ctr(d, t, y, f, c=WHITE):
    d.text(((W - tw(d, t, f)) / 2, y), t, font=f, fill=c)
    return y + th(d, t, f)

def rr(d, xy, r, fill, ol=None, ow=0):
    d.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=r, fill=fill)
    if ol:
        d.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=r, outline=ol, width=ow)

def person(d, cx, cy, sz, fill):
    hr = sz * 0.18
    d.ellipse([cx-hr, cy-sz*0.45-hr, cx+hr, cy-sz*0.45+hr], fill=fill)
    bt = cy - sz*0.45 + hr + sz*0.04
    bb = cy + sz*0.45
    bw = sz * 0.22
    d.rounded_rectangle([cx-bw, bt, cx+bw, bb], radius=sz*0.08, fill=fill)

def slabel(d, x, y, text, fill=AMBER, sz=50):
    f = F(sz, True)
    t = text.upper()
    d.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=fill)
    ly = y + th(d, t, f) + 12
    d.line([(x, ly), (x + tw(d, t, f), ly)], fill=fill, width=5)
    return ly + 30

def wrap(d, text, f, mw):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = f"{cur} {w}".strip()
        if tw(d, test, f) <= mw:
            cur = test
        else:
            if cur: lines.append(cur)
            cur = w
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines

def draw_lines_centered(d, text, y, f, mw, c=WHITE):
    for line in wrap(d, text, f, mw):
        y = ctr(d, line, y, f, c) + 6
    return y

def draw_lines_left(d, text, x, y, f, mw, c=WHITE):
    for line in wrap(d, text, f, mw):
        d.text((x, y), line, font=f, fill=c)
        y += th(d, line, f) + 8
    return y


def main():
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    M = 160
    CW = W - 2 * M

    # Accent bar
    d.rectangle([0, 0, W, 14], fill=AMBER)

    # ── HEADER ──
    y = 75
    y = ctr(d, "The State of Global Education", y, F(120, True)) + 12
    y = ctr(d, "Progress, Gaps, and Inequality", y, F(64), AMBER) + 22
    y = draw_lines_centered(d,
        "A comparative look at how far the world has come in expanding education access — and the critical gaps that remain.",
        y, F(42), CW - 100, LIGHT_GRAY) + 22
    d.line([(M, y), (W - M, y)], fill=MID_GRAY, width=3)
    y += 50

    # ── SECTION 1: PROGRESS ──
    y = slabel(d, M, y, "Two Centuries of Educational Expansion")
    pw = (CW - 80) // 2
    ph = 620
    lx, rx = M, M + pw + 80

    rr(d, [lx, y, lx+pw, y+ph], 30, BG_CARD)
    rr(d, [rx, y, rx+pw, y+ph], 30, BG_CARD)

    # 1800
    d.text((lx+60, y+40), "1800", font=F(60, True), fill=MID_GRAY)
    d.text((lx+60, y+120), "<1 in 5", font=F(140, True), fill=CORAL)
    d.text((lx+60, y+295), "adults had any formal", font=F(44), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    d.text((lx+60, y+350), "education", font=F(44), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    for i in range(10):
        person(d, lx+80+i*95, y+490, 75, CORAL if i < 2 else OFF_BG)

    # TODAY
    d.text((rx+60, y+40), "TODAY", font=F(60, True), fill=TEAL)
    d.text((rx+60, y+120), ">4 in 5", font=F(140, True), fill=TEAL)
    d.text((rx+60, y+295), "adults have received", font=F(44), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    d.text((rx+60, y+350), "formal education", font=F(44), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    for i in range(10):
        person(d, rx+80+i*95, y+490, 75, TEAL if i < 8 else OFF_BG)

    # Arrow
    acx = M + pw + 40
    acy = y + ph // 2
    d.polygon([(acx-30, acy-30), (acx+30, acy), (acx-30, acy+30)], fill=AMBER)

    y += ph + 70

    # ── SECTION 2: 244 MILLION HERO ──
    hh = 900
    rr(d, [M-50, y, W-M+50, y+hh], 45, HERO_BG, CORAL, 7)

    hy = y + 55
    hy = ctr(d, "THE CHALLENGE THAT REMAINS", hy, F(58, True), CORAL) + 35

    hy = ctr(d, "244", hy, F(380, True), WHITE) + 5
    hy = ctr(d, "MILLION", hy, F(130, True), CORAL) + 20
    hy = ctr(d, "children of school age are not in school", hy, F(62), LIGHT_GRAY) + 55

    # Breakdown bar
    bl = M + 140
    br = W - M - 140
    btw = br - bl
    bh = 100
    p_w = int(btw * (60 / 244))
    s_w = btw - p_w
    d.rounded_rectangle([bl, hy, bl+p_w-5, hy+bh], radius=20, fill=(255, 140, 60))
    d.rounded_rectangle([bl+p_w+5, hy, br, hy+bh], radius=20, fill=CORAL)
    d.text((bl+30, hy+28), "60M Primary", font=F(38, True), fill=WHITE)
    st = "184M Secondary"
    d.text((bl+p_w+5+(s_w-tw(d,st,F(38,True)))//2, hy+28), st, font=F(38, True), fill=WHITE)

    hy += bh + 40
    hy = draw_lines_centered(d,
        "Secondary-level dropout is the major driver — many who complete primary school do not continue.",
        hy, F(40), CW - 200, MID_GRAY)

    y += hh + 70

    # ── SECTION 3: LEARNING CRISIS + WORLD DIVIDED ──
    bph = 950
    bpw = (CW - 80) // 2
    lx2, rx2 = M, M + bpw + 80

    # LEFT: Learning Crisis
    rr(d, [lx2, y, lx2+bpw, y+bph], 30, BG_CARD)
    cy = y + 45
    cy = slabel(d, lx2+60, cy, "The Learning Crisis", sz=48)
    cy = draw_lines_left(d,
        "Being enrolled in school does not guarantee that children are actually learning.",
        lx2+60, cy, F(46), bpw-140, LIGHT_GRAY) + 30

    d.text((lx2+60, cy), "<20%", font=F(220, True), fill=CORAL)
    cy += th(d, "<20%", F(220, True)) + 25

    cy = draw_lines_left(d,
        "of children in low-income countries achieve minimum reading proficiency by end of primary school",
        lx2+60, cy, F(44), bpw-140, LIGHT_GRAY) + 40

    # Waffle
    csz, gp = 70, 16
    for i in range(10):
        cx = lx2 + 60 + i * (csz + gp)
        d.rounded_rectangle([cx, cy, cx+csz, cy+csz], radius=12,
                            fill=CORAL if i < 2 else OFF_BG)
    d.text((lx2+60, cy+csz+18), "Only 2 in 10 reach minimum reading level",
           font=F(34), fill=MID_GRAY)

    # RIGHT: World Divided
    rr(d, [rx2, y, rx2+bpw, y+bph], 30, BG_CARD)
    cy2 = y + 45
    cy2 = slabel(d, rx2+60, cy2, "A World Divided", sz=48)
    cy2 = draw_lines_left(d, "Learning-Adjusted Years of Schooling",
                          rx2+60, cy2, F(46), bpw-140, LIGHT_GRAY) + 40

    bars = [
        ("Poorest Countries", 2.8, "<3 yrs", CORAL),
        ("South Asia & Sub-Saharan Africa", 6.5, "<7 yrs", (255, 160, 80)),
        ("High-Income Countries", 10.5, "10+ yrs", TEAL),
    ]
    bmw = bpw - 200
    for label, val, vt, color in bars:
        d.text((rx2+60, cy2), label, font=F(40, True), fill=WHITE)
        cy2 += th(d, label, F(40, True)) + 16
        bw = int((val / 12) * bmw)
        d.rounded_rectangle([rx2+60, cy2, rx2+60+bw, cy2+80], radius=16, fill=color)
        d.text((rx2+78, cy2+18), vt, font=F(42, True), fill=WHITE)
        cy2 += 80 + 35

    cy2 += 25
    # Bold comparison
    cf = F(68, True)
    vf = F(48)
    c1, c2 = "<3 years", "10+ years"
    vs = "  vs  "
    total = tw(d, c1, cf) + tw(d, vs, vf) + tw(d, c2, cf)
    cx = rx2 + (bpw - total) // 2
    d.text((cx, cy2), c1, font=cf, fill=CORAL)
    cx += tw(d, c1, cf)
    d.text((cx, cy2+12), vs, font=vf, fill=MID_GRAY)
    cx += tw(d, vs, vf)
    d.text((cx, cy2), c2, font=cf, fill=TEAL)
    cy2 += th(d, c1, cf) + 25

    cy2 = draw_lines_left(d,
        "Children in the poorest nations receive less than a third of the quality schooling available in wealthy countries.",
        rx2+60, cy2, F(38), bpw-140, MID_GRAY)

    y += bph + 70

    # ── SECTION 4: GENDER GAP ──
    gh = 340
    rr(d, [M, y, W-M, y+gh], 30, BG_CARD)
    gy = y + 40
    gy = slabel(d, M+60, gy, "Closing the Gender Gap", sz=48)

    col_w = (CW - 200) // 3
    col_x = M + 80
    items = [
        ("Primary", "Nearly Closed", TEAL, True),
        ("Secondary", "Nearly Closed", TEAL, True),
        ("Tertiary", "Women Now Lead", AMBER, False),
    ]
    for i, (level, status, color, check) in enumerate(items):
        cx = col_x + i * col_w
        d.text((cx, gy+10), level, font=F(54, True), fill=WHITE)
        d.text((cx, gy+78), status, font=F(44), fill=color)
        if check:
            ck = cx + tw(d, status, F(44)) + 20
            d.text((ck, gy+74), "✓", font=F(48, True), fill=color)

    d.text((col_x, gy+160),
           "Exception: Significant gaps persist in countries like Afghanistan.",
           font=F(36), fill=MID_GRAY)

    y += gh + 70

    # ── KEY TAKEAWAY ──
    tkh = 370
    rr(d, [M, y, W-M, y+tkh], 30, TK_BG, AMBER, 5)
    ty = y + 50
    ty = ctr(d, "KEY TAKEAWAY", ty, F(58, True), AMBER) + 30
    ty = draw_lines_centered(d,
        "The world has achieved remarkable progress in education — but the job is far from done. "
        "Hundreds of millions of children are either out of school or learning very little while in it. "
        "Closing the gap between enrollment and actual learning is one of the most pressing challenges of our time.",
        ty, F(44), CW - 200, LIGHT_GRAY)

    # ── FOOTER ──
    fy = H - 100
    d.line([(M, fy-25), (W-M, fy-25)], fill=MID_GRAY, width=2)
    ctr(d, "Sources: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (2023) · World Bank Human Capital Index (2020) · Our World in Data",
        fy, F(32), MID_GRAY)
    d.rectangle([0, H-14, W, H], fill=AMBER)

    os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
    img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", "PNG", dpi=(150, 150))
    print(f"Poster saved: {W}x{H}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate A1 portrait poster: The State of Global Education."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os

W, H = 3508, 4961

BG = (25, 32, 48)
BG_CARD = (35, 45, 65)
AMBER = (255, 179, 43)
CORAL = (255, 99, 72)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
LIGHT_GRAY = (180, 190, 210)
MID_GRAY = (120, 135, 160)
TEAL = (72, 199, 190)
OFF_BG = (55, 65, 85)
HERO_BG = (50, 22, 22)
TK_BG = (40, 35, 25)

FONT_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"
FONT_REG = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"

_fc = {}
def F(size, bold=False):
    k = (size, bold)
    if k not in _fc:
        _fc[k] = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_BOLD if bold else FONT_REG, size)
    return _fc[k]

def tw(d, t, f):
    b = d.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f)
    return b[2] - b[0]

def th(d, t, f):
    b = d.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f)
    return b[3] - b[1]

def ctr(d, t, y, f, c=WHITE):
    d.text(((W - tw(d, t, f)) / 2, y), t, font=f, fill=c)
    return y + th(d, t, f)

def rr(d, xy, r, fill, ol=None, ow=0):
    d.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=r, fill=fill)
    if ol:
        d.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=r, outline=ol, width=ow)

def person(d, cx, cy, sz, fill):
    hr = sz * 0.18
    d.ellipse([cx-hr, cy-sz*0.45-hr, cx+hr, cy-sz*0.45+hr], fill=fill)
    bt = cy - sz*0.45 + hr + sz*0.04
    bb = cy + sz*0.45
    bw = sz * 0.22
    d.rounded_rectangle([cx-bw, bt, cx+bw, bb], radius=sz*0.08, fill=fill)

def slabel(d, x, y, text, fill=AMBER, sz=50):
    f = F(sz, True)
    t = text.upper()
    d.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=fill)
    ly = y + th(d, t, f) + 12
    d.line([(x, ly), (x + tw(d, t, f), ly)], fill=fill, width=5)
    return ly + 30

def wrap(d, text, f, mw):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = f"{cur} {w}".strip()
        if tw(d, test, f) <= mw:
            cur = test
        else:
            if cur: lines.append(cur)
            cur = w
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines

def draw_lines_centered(d, text, y, f, mw, c=WHITE):
    for line in wrap(d, text, f, mw):
        y = ctr(d, line, y, f, c) + 6
    return y

def draw_lines_left(d, text, x, y, f, mw, c=WHITE):
    for line in wrap(d, text, f, mw):
        d.text((x, y), line, font=f, fill=c)
        y += th(d, line, f) + 8
    return y


def main():
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    M = 160
    CW = W - 2 * M

    # Accent bar
    d.rectangle([0, 0, W, 14], fill=AMBER)

    # ── HEADER ──
    y = 75
    y = ctr(d, "The State of Global Education", y, F(120, True)) + 12
    y = ctr(d, "Progress, Gaps, and Inequality", y, F(64), AMBER) + 22
    y = draw_lines_centered(d,
        "A comparative look at how far the world has come in expanding education access — and the critical gaps that remain.",
        y, F(42), CW - 100, LIGHT_GRAY) + 22
    d.line([(M, y), (W - M, y)], fill=MID_GRAY, width=3)
    y += 50

    # ── SECTION 1: PROGRESS ──
    y = slabel(d, M, y, "Two Centuries of Educational Expansion")
    pw = (CW - 80) // 2
    ph = 620
    lx, rx = M, M + pw + 80

    rr(d, [lx, y, lx+pw, y+ph], 30, BG_CARD)
    rr(d, [rx, y, rx+pw, y+ph], 30, BG_CARD)

    # 1800
    d.text((lx+60, y+40), "1800", font=F(60, True), fill=MID_GRAY)
    d.text((lx+60, y+120), "<1 in 5", font=F(140, True), fill=CORAL)
    d.text((lx+60, y+295), "adults had any formal", font=F(44), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    d.text((lx+60, y+350), "education", font=F(44), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    for i in range(10):
        person(d, lx+80+i*95, y+490, 75, CORAL if i < 2 else OFF_BG)

    # TODAY
    d.text((rx+60, y+40), "TODAY", font=F(60, True), fill=TEAL)
    d.text((rx+60, y+120), ">4 in 5", font=F(140, True), fill=TEAL)
    d.text((rx+60, y+295), "adults have received", font=F(44), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    d.text((rx+60, y+350), "formal education", font=F(44), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    for i in range(10):
        person(d, rx+80+i*95, y+490, 75, TEAL if i < 8 else OFF_BG)

    # Arrow
    acx = M + pw + 40
    acy = y + ph // 2
    d.polygon([(acx-30, acy-30), (acx+30, acy), (acx-30, acy+30)], fill=AMBER)

    y += ph + 70

    # ── SECTION 2: 244 MILLION HERO ──
    hh = 900
    rr(d, [M-50, y, W-M+50, y+hh], 45, HERO_BG, CORAL, 7)

    hy = y + 55
    hy = ctr(d, "THE CHALLENGE THAT REMAINS", hy, F(58, True), CORAL) + 35

    hy = ctr(d, "244", hy, F(380, True), WHITE) + 5
    hy = ctr(d, "MILLION", hy, F(130, True), CORAL) + 20
    hy = ctr(d, "children of school age are not in school", hy, F(62), LIGHT_GRAY) + 55

    # Breakdown bar
    bl = M + 140
    br = W - M - 140
    btw = br - bl
    bh = 100
    p_w = int(btw * (60 / 244))
    s_w = btw - p_w
    d.rounded_rectangle([bl, hy, bl+p_w-5, hy+bh], radius=20, fill=(255, 140, 60))
    d.rounded_rectangle([bl+p_w+5, hy, br, hy+bh], radius=20, fill=CORAL)
    d.text((bl+30, hy+28), "60M Primary", font=F(38, True), fill=WHITE)
    st = "184M Secondary"
    d.text((bl+p_w+5+(s_w-tw(d,st,F(38,True)))//2, hy+28), st, font=F(38, True), fill=WHITE)

    hy += bh + 40
    hy = draw_lines_centered(d,
        "Secondary-level dropout is the major driver — many who complete primary school do not continue.",
        hy, F(40), CW - 200, MID_GRAY)

    y += hh + 70

    # ── SECTION 3: LEARNING CRISIS + WORLD DIVIDED ──
    bph = 950
    bpw = (CW - 80) // 2
    lx2, rx2 = M, M + bpw + 80

    # LEFT: Learning Crisis
    rr(d, [lx2, y, lx2+bpw, y+bph], 30, BG_CARD)
    cy = y + 45
    cy = slabel(d, lx2+60, cy, "The Learning Crisis", sz=48)
    cy = draw_lines_left(d,
        "Being enrolled in school does not guarantee that children are actually learning.",
        lx2+60, cy, F(46), bpw-140, LIGHT_GRAY) + 30

    d.text((lx2+60, cy), "<20%", font=F(220, True), fill=CORAL)
    cy += th(d, "<20%", F(220, True)) + 25

    cy = draw_lines_left(d,
        "of children in low-income countries achieve minimum reading proficiency by end of primary school",
        lx2+60, cy, F(44), bpw-140, LIGHT_GRAY) + 40

    # Waffle
    csz, gp = 70, 16
    for i in range(10):
        cx = lx2 + 60 + i * (csz + gp)
        d.rounded_rectangle([cx, cy, cx+csz, cy+csz], radius=12,
                            fill=CORAL if i < 2 else OFF_BG)
    d.text((lx2+60, cy+csz+18), "Only 2 in 10 reach minimum reading level",
           font=F(34), fill=MID_GRAY)

    # RIGHT: World Divided
    rr(d, [rx2, y, rx2+bpw, y+bph], 30, BG_CARD)
    cy2 = y + 45
    cy2 = slabel(d, rx2+60, cy2, "A World Divided", sz=48)
    cy2 = draw_lines_left(d, "Learning-Adjusted Years of Schooling",
                          rx2+60, cy2, F(46), bpw-140, LIGHT_GRAY) + 40

    bars = [
        ("Poorest Countries", 2.8, "<3 yrs", CORAL),
        ("South Asia & Sub-Saharan Africa", 6.5, "<7 yrs", (255, 160, 80)),
        ("High-Income Countries", 10.5, "10+ yrs", TEAL),
    ]
    bmw = bpw - 200
    for label, val, vt, color in bars:
        d.text((rx2+60, cy2), label, font=F(40, True), fill=WHITE)
        cy2 += th(d, label, F(40, True)) + 16
        bw = int((val / 12) * bmw)
        d.rounded_rectangle([rx2+60, cy2, rx2+60+bw, cy2+80], radius=16, fill=color)
        d.text((rx2+78, cy2+18), vt, font=F(42, True), fill=WHITE)
        cy2 += 80 + 35

    cy2 += 25
    # Bold comparison
    cf = F(68, True)
    vf = F(48)
    c1, c2 = "<3 years", "10+ years"
    vs = "  vs  "
    total = tw(d, c1, cf) + tw(d, vs, vf) + tw(d, c2, cf)
    cx = rx2 + (bpw - total) // 2
    d.text((cx, cy2), c1, font=cf, fill=CORAL)
    cx += tw(d, c1, cf)
    d.text((cx, cy2+12), vs, font=vf, fill=MID_GRAY)
    cx += tw(d, vs, vf)
    d.text((cx, cy2), c2, font=cf, fill=TEAL)
    cy2 += th(d, c1, cf) + 25

    cy2 = draw_lines_left(d,
        "Children in the poorest nations receive less than a third of the quality schooling available in wealthy countries.",
        rx2+60, cy2, F(38), bpw-140, MID_GRAY)

    y += bph + 70

    # ── SECTION 4: GENDER GAP ──
    gh = 340
    rr(d, [M, y, W-M, y+gh], 30, BG_CARD)
    gy = y + 40
    gy = slabel(d, M+60, gy, "Closing the Gender Gap", sz=48)

    col_w = (CW - 200) // 3
    col_x = M + 80
    items = [
        ("Primary", "Nearly Closed", TEAL, True),
        ("Secondary", "Nearly Closed", TEAL, True),
        ("Tertiary", "Women Now Lead", AMBER, False),
    ]
    for i, (level, status, color, check) in enumerate(items):
        cx = col_x + i * col_w
        d.text((cx, gy+10), level, font=F(54, True), fill=WHITE)
        d.text((cx, gy+78), status, font=F(44), fill=color)
        if check:
            ck = cx + tw(d, status, F(44)) + 20
            d.text((ck, gy+74), "✓", font=F(48, True), fill=color)

    d.text((col_x, gy+160),
           "Exception: Significant gaps persist in countries like Afghanistan.",
           font=F(36), fill=MID_GRAY)

    y += gh + 70

    # ── KEY TAKEAWAY ──
    tkh = 370
    rr(d, [M, y, W-M, y+tkh], 30, TK_BG, AMBER, 5)
    ty = y + 50
    ty = ctr(d, "KEY TAKEAWAY", ty, F(58, True), AMBER) + 30
    ty = draw_lines_centered(d,
        "The world has achieved remarkable progress in education — but the job is far from done. "
        "Hundreds of millions of children are either out of school or learning very little while in it. "
        "Closing the gap between enrollment and actual learning is one of the most pressing challenges of our time.",
        ty, F(44), CW - 200, LIGHT_GRAY)

    # ── FOOTER ──
    fy = H - 100
    d.line([(M, fy-25), (W-M, fy-25)], fill=MID_GRAY, width=2)
    ctr(d, "Sources: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (2023) · World Bank Human Capital Index (2020) · Our World in Data",
        fy, F(32), MID_GRAY)
    d.rectangle([0, H-14, W, H], fill=AMBER)

    os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
    img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", "PNG", dpi=(150, 150))
    print(f"Poster saved: {W}x{H}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

raw_arguments.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate A1 portrait poster: The State of Global Education."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os

W, H = 3508, 4961

BG = (25, 32, 48)
BG_CARD = (35, 45, 65)
AMBER = (255, 179, 43)
CORAL = (255, 99, 72)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
LIGHT_GRAY = (180, 190, 210)
MID_GRAY = (120, 135, 160)
TEAL = (72, 199, 190)
OFF_BG = (55, 65, 85)
HERO_BG = (50, 22, 22)
TK_BG = (40, 35, 25)

FONT_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"
FONT_REG = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"

_fc = {}
def F(size, bold=False):
    k = (size, bold)
    if k not in _fc:
        _fc[k] = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_BOLD if bold else FONT_REG, size)
    return _fc[k]

def tw(d, t, f):
    b = d.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f)
    return b[2] - b[0]

def th(d, t, f):
    b = d.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f)
    return b[3] - b[1]

def ctr(d, t, y, f, c=WHITE):
    d.text(((W - tw(d, t, f)) / 2, y), t, font=f, fill=c)
    return y + th(d, t, f)

def rr(d, xy, r, fill, ol=None, ow=0):
    d.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=r, fill=fill)
    if ol:
        d.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=r, outline=ol, width=ow)

def person(d, cx, cy, sz, fill):
    hr = sz * 0.18
    d.ellipse([cx-hr, cy-sz*0.45-hr, cx+hr, cy-sz*0.45+hr], fill=fill)
    bt = cy - sz*0.45 + hr + sz*0.04
    bb = cy + sz*0.45
    bw = sz * 0.22
    d.rounded_rectangle([cx-bw, bt, cx+bw, bb], radius=sz*0.08, fill=fill)

def slabel(d, x, y, text, fill=AMBER, sz=50):
    f = F(sz, True)
    t = text.upper()
    d.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=fill)
    ly = y + th(d, t, f) + 12
    d.line([(x, ly), (x + tw(d, t, f), ly)], fill=fill, width=5)
    return ly + 30

def wrap(d, text, f, mw):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = f"{cur} {w}".strip()
        if tw(d, test, f) <= mw:
            cur = test
        else:
            if cur: lines.append(cur)
            cur = w
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines

def draw_lines_centered(d, text, y, f, mw, c=WHITE):
    for line in wrap(d, text, f, mw):
        y = ctr(d, line, y, f, c) + 6
    return y

def draw_lines_left(d, text, x, y, f, mw, c=WHITE):
    for line in wrap(d, text, f, mw):
        d.text((x, y), line, font=f, fill=c)
        y += th(d, line, f) + 8
    return y


def main():
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    M = 160
    CW = W - 2 * M

    # Accent bar
    d.rectangle([0, 0, W, 14], fill=AMBER)

    # ── HEADER ──
    y = 75
    y = ctr(d, "The State of Global Education", y, F(120, True)) + 12
    y = ctr(d, "Progress, Gaps, and Inequality", y, F(64), AMBER) + 22
    y = draw_lines_centered(d,
        "A comparative look at how far the world has come in expanding education access — and the critical gaps that remain.",
        y, F(42), CW - 100, LIGHT_GRAY) + 22
    d.line([(M, y), (W - M, y)], fill=MID_GRAY, width=3)
    y += 50

    # ── SECTION 1: PROGRESS ──
    y = slabel(d, M, y, "Two Centuries of Educational Expansion")
    pw = (CW - 80) // 2
    ph = 620
    lx, rx = M, M + pw + 80

    rr(d, [lx, y, lx+pw, y+ph], 30, BG_CARD)
    rr(d, [rx, y, rx+pw, y+ph], 30, BG_CARD)

    # 1800
    d.text((lx+60, y+40), "1800", font=F(60, True), fill=MID_GRAY)
    d.text((lx+60, y+120), "<1 in 5", font=F(140, True), fill=CORAL)
    d.text((lx+60, y+295), "adults had any formal", font=F(44), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    d.text((lx+60, y+350), "education", font=F(44), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    for i in range(10):
        person(d, lx+80+i*95, y+490, 75, CORAL if i < 2 else OFF_BG)

    # TODAY
    d.text((rx+60, y+40), "TODAY", font=F(60, True), fill=TEAL)
    d.text((rx+60, y+120), ">4 in 5", font=F(140, True), fill=TEAL)
    d.text((rx+60, y+295), "adults have received", font=F(44), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    d.text((rx+60, y+350), "formal education", font=F(44), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    for i in range(10):
        person(d, rx+80+i*95, y+490, 75, TEAL if i < 8 else OFF_BG)

    # Arrow
    acx = M + pw + 40
    acy = y + ph // 2
    d.polygon([(acx-30, acy-30), (acx+30, acy), (acx-30, acy+30)], fill=AMBER)

    y += ph + 70

    # ── SECTION 2: 244 MILLION HERO ──
    hh = 900
    rr(d, [M-50, y, W-M+50, y+hh], 45, HERO_BG, CORAL, 7)

    hy = y + 55
    hy = ctr(d, "THE CHALLENGE THAT REMAINS", hy, F(58, True), CORAL) + 35

    hy = ctr(d, "244", hy, F(380, True), WHITE) + 5
    hy = ctr(d, "MILLION", hy, F(130, True), CORAL) + 20
    hy = ctr(d, "children of school age are not in school", hy, F(62), LIGHT_GRAY) + 55

    # Breakdown bar
    bl = M + 140
    br = W - M - 140
    btw = br - bl
    bh = 100
    p_w = int(btw * (60 / 244))
    s_w = btw - p_w
    d.rounded_rectangle([bl, hy, bl+p_w-5, hy+bh], radius=20, fill=(255, 140, 60))
    d.rounded_rectangle([bl+p_w+5, hy, br, hy+bh], radius=20, fill=CORAL)
    d.text((bl+30, hy+28), "60M Primary", font=F(38, True), fill=WHITE)
    st = "184M Secondary"
    d.text((bl+p_w+5+(s_w-tw(d,st,F(38,True)))//2, hy+28), st, font=F(38, True), fill=WHITE)

    hy += bh + 40
    hy = draw_lines_centered(d,
        "Secondary-level dropout is the major driver — many who complete primary school do not continue.",
        hy, F(40), CW - 200, MID_GRAY)

    y += hh + 70

    # ── SECTION 3: LEARNING CRISIS + WORLD DIVIDED ──
    bph = 950
    bpw = (CW - 80) // 2
    lx2, rx2 = M, M + bpw + 80

    # LEFT: Learning Crisis
    rr(d, [lx2, y, lx2+bpw, y+bph], 30, BG_CARD)
    cy = y + 45
    cy = slabel(d, lx2+60, cy, "The Learning Crisis", sz=48)
    cy = draw_lines_left(d,
        "Being enrolled in school does not guarantee that children are actually learning.",
        lx2+60, cy, F(46), bpw-140, LIGHT_GRAY) + 30

    d.text((lx2+60, cy), "<20%", font=F(220, True), fill=CORAL)
    cy += th(d, "<20%", F(220, True)) + 25

    cy = draw_lines_left(d,
        "of children in low-income countries achieve minimum reading proficiency by end of primary school",
        lx2+60, cy, F(44), bpw-140, LIGHT_GRAY) + 40

    # Waffle
    csz, gp = 70, 16
    for i in range(10):
        cx = lx2 + 60 + i * (csz + gp)
        d.rounded_rectangle([cx, cy, cx+csz, cy+csz], radius=12,
                            fill=CORAL if i < 2 else OFF_BG)
    d.text((lx2+60, cy+csz+18), "Only 2 in 10 reach minimum reading level",
           font=F(34), fill=MID_GRAY)

    # RIGHT: World Divided
    rr(d, [rx2, y, rx2+bpw, y+bph], 30, BG_CARD)
    cy2 = y + 45
    cy2 = slabel(d, rx2+60, cy2, "A World Divided", sz=48)
    cy2 = draw_lines_left(d, "Learning-Adjusted Years of Schooling",
                          rx2+60, cy2, F(46), bpw-140, LIGHT_GRAY) + 40

    bars = [
        ("Poorest Countries", 2.8, "<3 yrs", CORAL),
        ("South Asia & Sub-Saharan Africa", 6.5, "<7 yrs", (255, 160, 80)),
        ("High-Income Countries", 10.5, "10+ yrs", TEAL),
    ]
    bmw = bpw - 200
    for label, val, vt, color in bars:
        d.text((rx2+60, cy2), label, font=F(40, True), fill=WHITE)
        cy2 += th(d, label, F(40, True)) + 16
        bw = int((val / 12) * bmw)
        d.rounded_rectangle([rx2+60, cy2, rx2+60+bw, cy2+80], radius=16, fill=color)
        d.text((rx2+78, cy2+18), vt, font=F(42, True), fill=WHITE)
        cy2 += 80 + 35

    cy2 += 25
    # Bold comparison
    cf = F(68, True)
    vf = F(48)
    c1, c2 = "<3 years", "10+ years"
    vs = "  vs  "
    total = tw(d, c1, cf) + tw(d, vs, vf) + tw(d, c2, cf)
    cx = rx2 + (bpw - total) // 2
    d.text((cx, cy2), c1, font=cf, fill=CORAL)
    cx += tw(d, c1, cf)
    d.text((cx, cy2+12), vs, font=vf, fill=MID_GRAY)
    cx += tw(d, vs, vf)
    d.text((cx, cy2), c2, font=cf, fill=TEAL)
    cy2 += th(d, c1, cf) + 25

    cy2 = draw_lines_left(d,
        "Children in the poorest nations receive less than a third of the quality schooling available in wealthy countries.",
        rx2+60, cy2, F(38), bpw-140, MID_GRAY)

    y += bph + 70

    # ── SECTION 4: GENDER GAP ──
    gh = 340
    rr(d, [M, y, W-M, y+gh], 30, BG_CARD)
    gy = y + 40
    gy = slabel(d, M+60, gy, "Closing the Gender Gap", sz=48)

    col_w = (CW - 200) // 3
    col_x = M + 80
    items = [
        ("Primary", "Nearly Closed", TEAL, True),
        ("Secondary", "Nearly Closed", TEAL, True),
        ("Tertiary", "Women Now Lead", AMBER, False),
    ]
    for i, (level, status, color, check) in enumerate(items):
        cx = col_x + i * col_w
        d.text((cx, gy+10), level, font=F(54, True), fill=WHITE)
        d.text((cx, gy+78), status, font=F(44), fill=color)
        if check:
            ck = cx + tw(d, status, F(44)) + 20
            d.text((ck, gy+74), "✓", font=F(48, True), fill=color)

    d.text((col_x, gy+160),
           "Exception: Significant gaps persist in countries like Afghanistan.",
           font=F(36), fill=MID_GRAY)

    y += gh + 70

    # ── KEY TAKEAWAY ──
    tkh = 370
    rr(d, [M, y, W-M, y+tkh], 30, TK_BG, AMBER, 5)
    ty = y + 50
    ty = ctr(d, "KEY TAKEAWAY", ty, F(58, True), AMBER) + 30
    ty = draw_lines_centered(d,
        "The world has achieved remarkable progress in education — but the job is far from done. "
        "Hundreds of millions of children are either out of school or learning very little while in it. "
        "Closing the gap between enrollment and actual learning is one of the most pressing challenges of our time.",
        ty, F(44), CW - 200, LIGHT_GRAY)

    # ── FOOTER ──
    fy = H - 100
    d.line([(M, fy-25), (W-M, fy-25)], fill=MID_GRAY, width=2)
    ctr(d, "Sources: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (2023) · World Bank Human Capital Index (2020) · Our World in Data",
        fy, F(32), MID_GRAY)
    d.rectangle([0, H-14, W, H], fill=AMBER)

    os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
    img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", "PNG", dpi=(150, 150))
    print(f"Poster saved: {W}x{H}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def ctr(d, t, y, f, c=WHITE):
    d.text(((W - tw(d, t, f)) / 2, y), t, font=f, fill=c)

def rr(d, xy, r, fill, ol=None, ow=0):
    d.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=r, fill=fill)
    if ol:
        d.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=r, outline=ol, width=ow)

def person(d, cx, cy, sz, fill):
    hr = sz * 0.18
    d.ellipse([cx-hr, cy-sz*0.45-hr, cx+hr, cy-sz*0.45+hr], fill=fill)
    bt = cy - sz*0.45 + hr + sz*0.04
    bb = cy + sz*0.45
    bw = sz * 0.22
    d.rounded_rectangle([cx-bw, bt, cx+bw, bb], radius=sz*0.08, fill=fill)

def slabel(d, x, y, text, fill=AMBER, sz=50):
    f = F(sz, True)

"""Generate A1 portrait poster: The State of Global Education."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os

W, H = 3508, 4961

BG = (25, 32, 48)
BG_CARD = (35, 45, 65)
AMBER = (255, 179, 43)
CORAL = (255, 99, 72)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
LIGHT_GRAY = (180, 190, 210)
MID_GRAY = (120, 135, 160)
TEAL = (72, 199, 190)
OFF_BG = (55, 65, 85)
HERO_BG = (50, 22, 22)
TK_BG = (40, 35, 25)

FONT_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"
FONT_REG = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"

_fc = {}
def F(size, bold=False):
    k = (size, bold)

    return _fc[k]

def tw(d, t, f):
    b = d.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f)
    return b[2] - b[0]

def th(d, t, f):
    b = d.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f)
    return b[3] - b[1]

def ctr(d, t, y, f, c=WHITE):
    d.text(((W - tw(d, t, f)) / 2, y), t, font=f, fill=c)
    return y + th(d, t, f)

def rr(d, xy, r, fill, ol=None, ow=0):
    d.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=r, fill=fill)
    if ol:
        d.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=r, outline=ol, width=ow)

def person(d, cx, cy, sz, fill):
    hr = sz * 0.18
    d.ellipse([cx-hr, cy-sz*0.45-hr, cx+hr, cy-sz*0.45+hr], fill=fill)
    bt = cy - sz*0.45 + hr + sz*0.04
    bb = cy + sz*0.45
    bw = sz * 0.22
    d.rounded_rectangle([cx-bw, bt, cx+bw, bb], radius=sz*0.08, fill=fill)

def slabel(d, x, y, text, fill=AMBER, sz=50):
    f = F(sz, True)
    t = text.upper()
    d.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=fill)
    ly = y + th(d, t, f) + 12
    d.line([(x, ly), (x + tw(d, t, f), ly)], fill=fill, width=5)
    return ly + 30

def wrap(d, text, f, mw):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = f"{cur} {w}".strip()
        if tw(d, test, f) <= mw:
            cur = test
        else:
            if cur: lines.append(cur)
            cur = w

    y = ctr(d, "Progress, Gaps, and Inequality", y, F(64), AMBER) + 22
    y = draw_lines_centered(d,
        "A comparative look at how far the world has come in expanding education access — and the critical gaps that remain.",

    rr(d, [rx, y, rx+pw, y+ph], 30, BG_CARD)

    # 1800
    d.text((lx+60, y+40), "1800", font=F(60, True), fill=MID_GRAY)
    d.text((lx+60, y+120), "<1 in 5", font=F(140, True), fill=CORAL)
    d.text((lx+60, y+295), "adults had any formal", font=F(44), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    d.text((lx+60, y+350), "education", font=F(44), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    for i in range(10):
        person(d, lx+80+i*95, y+540, 80, CORAL if i < 2 else OFF_BG)

    # TODAY
    d.text((rx+60, y+40), "TODAY", font=F(60, True), fill=TEAL)
    d.text((rx+60, y+120), ">4 in 5", font=F(140, True), fill=TEAL)
    d.text((rx+60, y+295), "adults have received", font=F(44), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    d.text((rx+60, y+350), "formal education", font=F(44), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    for i in range(10):
        person(d, rx+80+i*95, y+540, 80, TEAL if i < 8 else OFF_BG)

    # Arrow
    acx = M + pw + 40
    acy = y + ph // 2
    d.polygon([(acx-30, acy-30), (acx+30, acy), (acx-30, acy+30)], fill=AMBER)

    y += ph + 80

    # ── SECTION 2: 244 MILLION HERO ──
    hh = 1050
    rr(d, [M-50, y, W-M+50, y+hh], 45, HERO_BG, CORAL, 7)

    hy = y + 55
    hy = ctr(d, "THE CHALLENGE THAT REMAINS", hy, F(58, True), CORAL) + 35

    hy = ctr(d, "244", hy, F(380, True), WHITE) + 5

    d.rounded_rectangle([bl, hy, bl+p_w-5, hy+bh], radius=20, fill=(255, 140, 60))
    d.rounded_rectangle([bl+p_w+5, hy, br, hy+bh], radius=20, fill=CORAL)
    d.text((bl+30, hy+28), "60M Primary", font=F(38, True), fill=WHITE)
    st = "184M Secondary"
    d.text((bl+p_w+5+(s_w-tw(d,st,F(38,True)))//2, hy+28), st, font=F(38, True), fill=WHITE)

    hy += bh + 40
    hy = draw_lines_centered(d,
        "Secondary-level dropout is the major driver — many who complete primary school do not continue.",

    y += hh + 80

    # ── SECTION 3: LEARNING CRISIS + WORLD DIVIDED ──
    bph = 1050
    bpw = (CW - 80) // 2
    lx2, rx2 = M, M + bpw + 80

    # LEFT: Learning Crisis
    rr(d, [lx2, y, lx2+bpw, y+bph], 30, BG_CARD)
    cy = y + 45
    cy = slabel(d, lx2+60, cy, "The Learning Crisis", sz=48)
    cy = draw_lines_left(d,
        "Being enrolled in school does not guarantee that children are actually learning.",
        lx2+60, cy, F(46), bpw-140, LIGHT_GRAY) + 30

    d.text((lx2+60, cy), "<20%", font=F(220, True), fill=CORAL)
    cy += th(d, "<20%", F(220, True)) + 25

    cy = draw_lines_left(d,
        "of children in low-income countries achieve minimum reading proficiency by end of primary school",
        lx2+60, cy, F(44), bpw-140, LIGHT_GRAY) + 40

    # Waffle
    csz, gp = 70, 16
    for i in range(10):
        cx = lx2 + 60 + i * (csz + gp)
        d.rounded_rectangle([cx, cy, cx+csz, cy+csz], radius=12,
                            fill=CORAL if i < 2 else OFF_BG)
    d.text((lx2+60, cy+csz+18), "Only 2 in 10 reach minimum reading level",
           font=F(34), fill=MID_GRAY)

    # RIGHT: World Divided
    rr(d, [rx2, y, rx2+bpw, y+bph], 30, BG_CARD)
    cy2 = y + 45
    cy2 = slabel(d, rx2+60, cy2, "A World Divided", sz=48)
    cy2 = draw_lines_left(d, "Learning-Adjusted Years of Schooling",
                          rx2+60, cy2, F(46), bpw-140, LIGHT_GRAY) + 40

    bars = [
        ("Poorest Countries", 2.8, "<3 yrs", CORAL),
        ("South Asia & Sub-Saharan Africa", 6.5, "<7 yrs", (255, 160, 80)),
        ("High-Income Countries", 10.5, "10+ yrs", TEAL),
    ]
    bmw = bpw - 200
    for label, val, vt, color in bars:
        d.text((rx2+60, cy2), label, font=F(40, True), fill=WHITE)
        cy2 += th(d, label, F(40, True)) + 16
        bw = int((val / 12) * bmw)
        d.rounded_rectangle([rx2+60, cy2, rx2+60+bw, cy2+80], radius=16, fill=color)
        d.text((rx2+78, cy2+18), vt, font=F(42, True), fill=WHITE)
        cy2 += 80 + 35

    cy2 += 25
    # Bold comparison
    cf = F(68, True)
    vf = F(48)
    c1, c2 = "<3 years", "10+ years"
    vs = "  vs  "

    cx = rx2 + (bpw - total) // 2
    d.text((cx, cy2), c1, font=cf, fill=CORAL)
    cx += tw(d, c1, cf)
    d.text((cx, cy2+12), vs, font=vf, fill=MID_GRAY)
    cx += tw(d, vs, vf)
    d.text((cx, cy2), c2, font=cf, fill=TEAL)
    cy2 += th(d, c1, cf) + 25

    cy2 = draw_lines_left(d,
        "Children in the poorest nations receive less than a third of the quality schooling available in wealthy countries.",
        rx2+60, cy2, F(38), bpw-140, MID_GRAY)

           font=F(36), fill=MID_GRAY)

        "Closing the gap between enrollment and actual learning is one of the most pressing challenges of our time.",

    d.line([(M, fy-20), (W-M, fy-20)], fill=MID_GRAY, width=2)
    ctr(d, "Sources: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (2023) · World Bank Human Capital Index (2020) · Our World in Data",
        fy, F(32), MID_GRAY)
    d.rectangle([0, H-14, W, H], fill=AMBER)

    os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
    img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", "PNG", dpi=(150, 150))

_fc = {}

    b = d.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f)

    hr = sz * 0.18

    f = F(sz, True)
    t = text.upper()

    ly = y + th(d, t, f) + 12
    d.line([(x, ly), (x + tw(d, t, f), ly)], fill=fill, width=5)
    return ly + 30

    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = f"{cur} {w}".strip()
        if tw(d, test, f) <= mw:
            cur = test
        else:
            if cur: lines.append(cur)
            cur = w
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines

    for line in wrap(d, text, f, mw):
        y = ctr(d, line, y, f, c) + 6
    return y

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate A1 portrait poster: The State of Global Education."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os

W, H = 3508, 4961

BG = (25, 32, 48)
BG_CARD = (35, 45, 65)
AMBER = (255, 179, 43)
CORAL = (255, 99, 72)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
LIGHT_GRAY = (180, 190, 210)
MID_GRAY = (120, 135, 160)
TEAL = (72, 199, 190)
OFF_BG = (55, 65, 85)
HERO_BG = (50, 22, 22)
TK_BG = (40, 35, 25)

FONT_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"
FONT_REG = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"

_fc = {}
def F(size, bold=False):
    k = (size, bold)
    if k not in _fc:
        _fc[k] = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_BOLD if bold else FONT_REG, size)
    return _fc[k]

def tw(d, t, f):
    b = d.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f)
    return b[2] - b[0]

def th(d, t, f):
    b = d.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f)
    return b[3] - b[1]

def ctr(d, t, y, f, c=WHITE):
    d.text(((W - tw(d, t, f)) / 2, y), t, font=f, fill=c)
    return y + th(d, t, f)

def rr(d, xy, r, fill, ol=None, ow=0):
    d.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=r, fill=fill)
    if ol:
        d.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=r, outline=ol, width=ow)

def person(d, cx, cy, sz, fill):
    hr = sz * 0.18
    d.ellipse([cx-hr, cy-sz*0.45-hr, cx+hr, cy-sz*0.45+hr], fill=fill)
    bt = cy - sz*0.45 + hr + sz*0.04
    bb = cy + sz*0.45
    bw = sz * 0.22
    d.rounded_rectangle([cx-bw, bt, cx+bw, bb], radius=sz*0.08, fill=fill)

def slabel(d, x, y, text, fill=AMBER, sz=50):
    f = F(sz, True)
    t = text.upper()
    d.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=fill)
    ly = y + th(d, t, f) + 12
    d.line([(x, ly), (x + tw(d, t, f), ly)], fill=fill, width=5)
    return ly + 30

def wrap(d, text, f, mw):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = f"{cur} {w}".strip()
        if tw(d, test, f) <= mw:
            cur = test
        else:
            if cur: lines.append(cur)
            cur = w
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines

def draw_lines_centered(d, text, y, f, mw, c=WHITE):
    for line in wrap(d, text, f, mw):
        y = ctr(d, line, y, f, c) + 6
    return y

def draw_lines_left(d, text, x, y, f, mw, c=WHITE):
    for line in wrap(d, text, f, mw):
        d.text((x, y), line, font=f, fill=c)
        y += th(d, line, f) + 8
    return y


def main():
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    M = 160
    CW = W - 2 * M

    # Accent bar
    d.rectangle([0, 0, W, 14], fill=AMBER)

    # ── HEADER ──
    y = 75
    y = ctr(d, "The State of Global Education", y, F(120, True)) + 12
    y = ctr(d, "Progress, Gaps, and Inequality", y, F(64), AMBER) + 22
    y = draw_lines_centered(d,
        "A comparative look at how far the world has come in expanding education access — and the critical gaps that remain.",
        y, F(42), CW - 100, LIGHT_GRAY) + 22
    d.line([(M, y), (W - M, y)], fill=MID_GRAY, width=3)
    y += 50

    # ── SECTION 1: PROGRESS ──
    y = slabel(d, M, y, "Two Centuries of Educational Expansion")
    pw = (CW - 80) // 2
    ph = 680
    lx, rx = M, M + pw + 80

    rr(d, [lx, y, lx+pw, y+ph], 30, BG_CARD)
    rr(d, [rx, y, rx+pw, y+ph], 30, BG_CARD)

    # 1800
    d.text((lx+60, y+40), "1800", font=F(60, True), fill=MID_GRAY)
    d.text((lx+60, y+120), "<1 in 5", font=F(140, True), fill=CORAL)
    d.text((lx+60, y+295), "adults had any formal", font=F(44), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    d.text((lx+60, y+350), "education", font=F(44), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    for i in range(10):
        person(d, lx+80+i*95, y+540, 80, CORAL if i < 2 else OFF_BG)

    # TODAY
    d.text((rx+60, y+40), "TODAY", font=F(60, True), fill=TEAL)
    d.text((rx+60, y+120), ">4 in 5", font=F(140, True), fill=TEAL)
    d.text((rx+60, y+295), "adults have received", font=F(44), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    d.text((rx+60, y+350), "formal education", font=F(44), fill=LIGHT_GRAY)
    for i in range(10):
        person(d, rx+80+i*95, y+540, 80, TEAL if i < 8 else OFF_BG)

    # Arrow
    acx = M + pw + 40
    acy = y + ph // 2
    d.polygon([(acx-30, acy-30), (acx+30, acy), (acx-30, acy+30)], fill=AMBER)

    y += ph + 80

    # ── SECTION 2: 244 MILLION HERO ──
    hh = 1130
    rr(d, [M-50, y, W-M+50, y+hh], 45, HERO_BG, CORAL, 7)

    hy = y + 60
    hy = ctr(d, "THE CHALLENGE THAT REMAINS", hy, F(58, True), CORAL) + 45

    hy = ctr(d, "244", hy, F(420, True), WHITE) + 50
    hy = ctr(d, "MILLION", hy, F(140, True), CORAL) + 30
    hy = ctr(d, "children of school age are not in school", hy, F(64), LIGHT_GRAY) + 60

    # Breakdown bar
    bl = M + 140
    br = W - M - 140
    btw = br - bl
    bh = 100
    p_w = int(btw * (60 / 244))
    s_w = btw - p_w
    d.rounded_rectangle([bl, hy, bl+p_w-5, hy+bh], radius=20, fill=(255, 140, 60))
    d.rounded_rectangle([bl+p_w+5, hy, br, hy+bh], radius=20, fill=CORAL)
    d.text((bl+30, hy+28), "60M Primary", font=F(38, True), fill=WHITE)
    st = "184M Secondary"
    d.text((bl+p_w+5+(s_w-tw(d,st,F(38,True)))//2, hy+28), st, font=F(38, True), fill=WHITE)

    hy += bh + 40
    hy = draw_lines_centered(d,
        "Secondary-level dropout is the major driver — many who complete primary school do not continue.",
        hy, F(40), CW - 200, MID_GRAY)

    y += hh + 80

    # ── SECTION 3: LEARNING CRISIS + WORLD DIVIDED ──
    bph = 1050
    bpw = (CW - 80) // 2
    lx2, rx2 = M, M + bpw + 80

    # LEFT: Learning Crisis
    rr(d, [lx2, y, lx2+bpw, y+bph], 30, BG_CARD)
    cy = y + 45
    cy = slabel(d, lx2+60, cy, "The Learning Crisis", sz=48)
    cy = draw_lines_left(d,
        "Being enrolled in school does not guarantee that children are actually learning.",
        lx2+60, cy, F(46), bpw-140, LIGHT_GRAY) + 30

    d.text((lx2+60, cy), "<20%", font=F(220, True), fill=CORAL)
    cy += th(d, "<20%", F(220, True)) + 25

    cy = draw_lines_left(d,
        "of children in low-income countries achieve minimum reading proficiency by end of primary school",
        lx2+60, cy, F(44), bpw-140, LIGHT_GRAY) + 40

    # Waffle
    csz, gp = 70, 16
    for i in range(10):
        cx = lx2 + 60 + i * (csz + gp)
        d.rounded_rectangle([cx, cy, cx+csz, cy+csz], radius=12,
                            fill=CORAL if i < 2 else OFF_BG)
    d.text((lx2+60, cy+csz+18), "Only 2 in 10 reach minimum reading level",
           font=F(34), fill=MID_GRAY)

    # RIGHT: World Divided
    rr(d, [rx2, y, rx2+bpw, y+bph], 30, BG_CARD)
    cy2 = y + 45
    cy2 = slabel(d, rx2+60, cy2, "A World Divided", sz=48)
    cy2 = draw_lines_left(d, "Learning-Adjusted Years of Schooling",
                          rx2+60, cy2, F(46), bpw-140, LIGHT_GRAY) + 40

    bars = [
        ("Poorest Countries", 2.8, "<3 yrs", CORAL),
        ("South Asia & Sub-Saharan Africa", 6.5, "<7 yrs", (255, 160, 80)),
        ("High-Income Countries", 10.5, "10+ yrs", TEAL),
    ]
    bmw = bpw - 200
    for label, val, vt, color in bars:
        d.text((rx2+60, cy2), label, font=F(40, True), fill=WHITE)
        cy2 += th(d, label, F(40, True)) + 16
        bw = int((val / 12) * bmw)
        d.rounded_rectangle([rx2+60, cy2, rx2+60+bw, cy2+80], radius=16, fill=color)
        d.text((rx2+78, cy2+18), vt, font=F(42, True), fill=WHITE)
        cy2 += 80 + 35

    cy2 += 25
    # Bold comparison
    cf = F(68, True)
    vf = F(48)
    c1, c2 = "<3 years", "10+ years"
    vs = "  vs  "
    total = tw(d, c1, cf) + tw(d, vs, vf) + tw(d, c2, cf)
    cx = rx2 + (bpw - total) // 2
    d.text((cx, cy2), c1, font=cf, fill=CORAL)
    cx += tw(d, c1, cf)
    d.text((cx, cy2+12), vs, font=vf, fill=MID_GRAY)
    cx += tw(d, vs, vf)
    d.text((cx, cy2), c2, font=cf, fill=TEAL)
    cy2 += th(d, c1, cf) + 25

    cy2 = draw_lines_left(d,
        "Children in the poorest nations receive less than a third of the quality schooling available in wealthy countries.",
        rx2+60, cy2, F(38), bpw-140, MID_GRAY)

    y += bph + 80

    # ── SECTION 4: GENDER GAP ──
    gh = 380
    rr(d, [M, y, W-M, y+gh], 30, BG_CARD)
    gy = y + 40
    gy = slabel(d, M+60, gy, "Closing the Gender Gap", sz=48)

    col_w = (CW - 200) // 3
    col_x = M + 80
    items = [
        ("Primary", "Nearly Closed", TEAL, True),
        ("Secondary", "Nearly Closed", TEAL, True),
        ("Tertiary", "Women Now Lead", AMBER, False),
    ]
    for i, (level, status, color, check) in enumerate(items):
        cx = col_x + i * col_w
        d.text((cx, gy+10), level, font=F(54, True), fill=WHITE)
        d.text((cx, gy+78), status, font=F(44), fill=color)
        if check:
            ck = cx + tw(d, status, F(44)) + 20
            d.text((ck, gy+74), "✓", font=F(48, True), fill=color)

    d.text((col_x, gy+160),
           "Exception: Significant gaps persist in countries like Afghanistan.",
           font=F(36), fill=MID_GRAY)

    y += gh + 80

    # ── KEY TAKEAWAY ──
    tkh = 400
    rr(d, [M, y, W-M, y+tkh], 30, TK_BG, AMBER, 5)
    ty = y + 50
    ty = ctr(d, "KEY TAKEAWAY", ty, F(58, True), AMBER) + 30
    ty = draw_lines_centered(d,
        "The world has achieved remarkable progress in education — but the job is far from done. "
        "Hundreds of millions of children are either out of school or learning very little while in it. "
        "Closing the gap between enrollment and actual learning is one of the most pressing challenges of our time.",
        ty, F(44), CW - 200, LIGHT_GRAY)

    # ── FOOTER ──
    fy = H - 85
    d.line([(M, fy-20), (W-M, fy-20)], fill=MID_GRAY, width=2)
    ctr(d, "Sources: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (2023) · World Bank Human Capital Index (2020) · Our World in Data",
        fy, F(32), MID_GRAY)
    d.rectangle([0, H-14, W, H], fill=AMBER)

    os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
    img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", "PNG", dpi=(150, 150))
    print(f"Poster saved: {W}x{H}")
